title: Your Majesty, Your Male Favorite Is a Woman in Disguise
author: Bu Jue Xiao Sheng
synopsis:
Waking up, she found herself transformed into the male concubine of a cut-sleeve emperor. 

Thinking she was favored, she never expected to be locked in the Cold Palace for five full years... Truly a disaster! 

Unexpectedly, roasting a fish drew the mad dog emperor's own younger brother to her doorstep. 

The next day, looking at the bright yellow imperial edict in her hand, she had a genuine headache. 

She had inexplicably become the favored imperial concubine of the cut-sleeve emperor?! 

Su Yuqing: Holy crap! Why has this cut-sleeve dog emperor set his sights on me?! 

Lin Mingchuan curved his lips into a smile: My beloved consort, what's wrong? Are you feeling unwell? 

Su Yuqing gave a dry laugh: I am feeling rather unwell, you dog emperor using me as a shield, aren't you! 

Exchanging blows back and forth, the two of them sparked intense chemistry. In his wildest dreams, Lin Mingchuan never expected...

chapters.title: Turned into a Male Concubine?!
chapters.content:
The youth who previously showed no signs of life on the couch suddenly moved. He struggled to sit up, his vision gradually clearing from blurriness.

A dilapidated ancient-style bed, a rickety wooden door, the bleak, chilly wind...

The youth tightened his clothes around himself, freezing in place.

It took him a long while to slowly regain his wits.

His pupils shrank abruptly, and he couldn't help cursing out loud, "Holy crap! I've actually become... a male concubine?! And got thrown straight into the Cold Palace for five years!"

Then he felt a wave of relief, "Good thing, good thing, I'm still a girl, I didn't grow that extra thing..."

Memories rolled continuously in his mind. The original body's father was no good; he favored concubines and neglected his wife, and for the sake of wealth and glory, he didn't hesitate to risk the crime of deceiving the emperor by disguising his first wife's daughter as a boy and sending her into the palace.

If this were ever exposed, the original owner would be a dead person!

And this original owner was an absolute fool, believing every single word her scummy father said, enduring bullying from her concubine-born siblings without a peep.

There was another thing that made her even more furious: her fiancé had long been carrying on a clandestine affair with that green-tea, white-lotus concubine-born stepsister. Anyone with eyes could see it, yet the original owner still kept making excuses for that fiancé.

Su Yuqing took a deep breath and slowly let it out. Don't get angry, don't get angry; getting sick brings no substitutes.

Whatever, she'd settle scores with them all together once she crossed paths with them.

The original owner was the legitimate daughter of a proper, legally wedded first wife, yet she had died a miserable death right here in this Cold Palace.

Sigh~ Such are the vicissitudes of the world~

Forget it, forget it, what a mess of troubles.

No more thinking about it.

Su Yuqing raised a hand to rub her throbbing stomach, weakly propped up her body, and slowly walked out into the courtyard. A pear tree laden with fruit instantly made her eyes light up.

[Xiaobao, Xiaobao, look, Mother has woken up!]

[Really?!]

Two birds eagerly fluttered over toward Su Yuqing.

Su Yuqing was dumbfounded. Holy cow, the two birds the original owner saved were... two golden eagles?!

Good grief, two national first-class protected animals!!

[Mother!] A voice full of joy rang out.

The golden eagle in her arms raised its head, a pair of amber eyes staring fixedly at her.

[Umm, Big Brother, why isn't Mother petting our feathers? We washed them until they were so clean...]

Su Yuqing was overwhelmed by this massive surprise, and simultaneously knocked flat onto the ground.

It took her quite a while to recover.

Hahaha... Heaven has eyes; even in a new body, she could still understand animal language.

Su Yuqing reached out to stroke the feathers of the golden eagle in her arms, thought for a moment, and decided to speak up, "Where did you two go? Hm?"

The two golden eagles exchanged glances.

One of them spoke:

[Big Brother, you tell me, who is Mother talking to?]

Neither golden eagle imagined that Su Yuqing could hear them.

Listening to this silly remark, Su Yuqing chuckled out loud and ruffled the head of the golden eagle on the left, "I'm talking to you guys, Dabao and Xiaobao!"

The two golden eagles were shocked: Mother could hear them?!

Xiaobao shoved its brother aside with its body, its tone brimming with excitement.

[Mother, Mother, want a hug~]

Xiaobao spread its wings wide, its amber eyes filled with anticipation.

Dabao lifted its gaze, its tone languid.

[Didn't you see Mother fall to the ground? Get up already.]

Xiaobao felt terribly wronged. It retracted its wings, climbed off Su Yuqing, and immediately snapped back angrily.

[Hmph! Big Brother, you're cheating, you jumped on Mother too!]

Su Yuqing couldn't help laughing, pulling both golden eagles into her embrace.

"Alright, alright, hugs for everyone, what's a big deal?"

[Mother, do you want to eat that fruit?]

Xiaobao remembered the happy expression on Mother's face when she looked at that tree just now.

Dabao spread its wings and took flight. When it landed again, its talons clutched a branch laden with four pears.

It nudged the branch toward Su Yuqing with its head.

[Mother, for you to eat.]

Xiaobao threw a fit, extremely displeased.

[Dabao, you're cheating again!]

Dabao cast a aloof and noble glance at it and dropped a single sentence:

[Mother is hungry.]

Xiaobao: [...] Furious, but forced to hold it in.

Su Yuqing let out a soft laugh, which eventually escalated into a full belly-laugh until her waist ached.

These two golden eagles were absolute characters!

Su Yuqing massaged her aching lower back, picked up one of the pears, wiped it against her clothes, and took a bite.

The pear was full of juice, sweet, and quite nice.

After filling her stomach, Su Yuqing surveyed her surroundings and resignedly set about cleaning up this dilapidated Cold Palace.

She might have to live in this place for quite a long time, and tidying it up would put her in a better mood.

Still, given the chance, she intended to get out. Judging from the original owner's memories, the prosperity of the Qiyuan Dynasty was no less than that of the era belonging to the "Immortal of Poetry."

[Mother, we'll help you!]

The two golden eagles were exceptionally enthusiastic.

Su Yuqing curved her lips into a smile, "Alright!"

As the sun sank in the west, the red glow on the distant horizon dyed the sky fiery red, making for a breathtaking sight.

Su Yuqing's exhausted body slumped onto the bed, panting softly, "Oh lord, I am so tired..."

She raised a hand to massage her sore waist, and her stomach timely let out a rumble.

The two golden eagles came over holding two plump fish in their beaks, dropped them before Su Yuqing, and said:

[Mother, for you to eat!]

Su Yuqing's eyes lit up. These two golden eagles were way too well-behaved!

Xiaobao tilted its head, its gaze filled with confusion.

[Is Mother not going to eat?]

Su Yuqing quickly replied, "Eat, why wouldn't I eat!"

Su Yuqing picked up the fish and headed straight for the Cold Palace's kitchen. There were quite a few cooking utensils in there, likely smuggled in by deposed imperial concubines trying to live a little more comfortably.

At first, she had been quite shocked that the Cold Palace actually had a kitchen.

Still, it certainly benefited her.

Su Yuqing efficiently prepped the fish, washed some odor-removing herbs she found in the courtyard, and marinated the fish.

In the courtyard, Su Yuqing started a fire. Judging that the time was right, she placed the fish onto a makeshift grill.

As seconds ticked away, the fish on the grill began to emit a sizzling, fragrant aroma, its surface turning an appetizing, beautiful golden-brown.

Su Yuqing couldn't help swallowing her saliva.

It smelled so good, she couldn't take it anymore!

Never mind, she'd wait just a little longer!

Outside the Cold Palace:

A man in green robes, strolling about in boredom, paused right in front of the Cold Palace gates.

He twitched his nose, sniffed the air, and a look of confusion crossed his eyes.

Why is there a smell of roasted fish?

And it's coming from the Cold Palace. I haven't heard of His Imperial Brother deposing any concubines lately...

The man in green frowned and decided to go in and take a look.

"Xiaobao, is it delicious?" Su Yuqing tore off a piece of fish meat, blew on it, and fed it to the golden eagle in front of her.

Xiaobao snapped the fish into its mouth, swallowed it in one gulp, and leaned forward again.

[Mother, fish meat is delicious!]

Dabao felt wronged and leaned forward too.

[Mother, I want some too!]

Su Yuqing smiled helplessly and fed Dabao as well.

Vaulting over the wall, the green-robed man was met with precisely this scene.

A pair of phoenix eyes filled with shock.

They're actually raising two golden eagles?!

Such ferocious creatures, kept inside the Cold Palace?

That person looks young, and has a great figure too. Could it be they hold unrequited love for His Imperial Brother turning into hatred, and want to use these golden eagles to assassinate him?!

No, no, that is simply too terrifying!

He absolutely had to stop this!

"Hey~ my good sir, are you here to freeload?" Su Yuqing called out loudly.

The green-robed man snapped back to his senses in a hurry, only to see a person resembling an immortal standing beneath the wall alongside two imposing golden eagles.

The green-robed man offered an awkward smile, "You... are you my imperial brother's concubine?"

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow, her red lips parting, "Nope."

Before she even got to lay eyes on that dog emperor, she got dumped into the Cold Palace by him. Since she was deposed, being a concubine had nothing to do with her anymore.

The green-robed man frowned, "You... could you be my imperial father's concubine?!" Then he immediately began to negate his own thought.

"That's not right, I've met all of Imperial Father's concubines, and I haven't seen you. Could it be Imperial Father hid a beauty in a golden house, got caught, and was forced to banish you to the Cold Palace?"

Su Yuqing: "..." She thought her own imagination was wild, but damn...

chapters.title: I Am Su Yuqing
chapters.content:
[Dabao, this guy is a total dummy, we don't need to watch him anymore. Let's go help Mother watch the roasted fish,] Xiaobao looked at Dabao.

Dabao nodded in agreement.

Both golden eagles simultaneously spread their wings and flew back over to the campfire.

Su Yuqing had been working hard all afternoon and was starving right now. "Do as you please, I'm hungry and going to fill my stomach first~"

With that, she turned and walked toward the fire.

"Wait!" A flash of realization abruptly crossed the green-robed man's mind as he vaulted down to land right in front of Su Yuqing. "You are my imperial brother's concubine! All of Imperial Father's concubines are dead!"

Su Yuqing glanced at him indifferently, "Oh."

The green-robed man chuckled, wearing a thoroughly gossipy expression, "Hey, how'd you get deposed anyway?"

"I'm not called 'Hey', I am Su Yuqing," Su Yuqing corrected him.

"Oh~ Su Yuqing... You're Su Yuqing?!" The green-robed man suddenly widened a pair of phoenix eyes and let out an exclamation.

Alarm bells started ringing loudly in Su Yuqing's head, though her expression remained completely calm, "You know me?"

"Is your dad Su Ming?" the green-robed man probed cautiously.

Su Yuqing rummaged through her memories, clicking her tongue in disdain, "Though I'd rather not admit it, yes, he is."

That was the original owner's scummy dad.

A flicker crossed the green-robed man's gaze as a smile formed at the corner of his lips, "Your dad is now the prime minister, one person below ten thousand."

Su Yuqing snorted coldly, "Is that so~"

"Yeah, yeah, aren't you hap..."

The green-robed man's smile grew even brighter.

"Heaven truly has no eyes for letting a piece of trash like that become prime minister?!" Su Yuqing spat, cutting him off.

The smile froze on the green-robed man's face. His own father became prime minister and this son wasn't even happy?!

Oh~ Come to think of it, ever since his imperial brother proclaimed to the world that he favored men, officials presented him with handsome youths every year. This Su Yuqing was probably one of those beauties. To put it nicely, he was an imperial concubine; to put it bluntly, nothing more than a male concubine serving the emperor with his looks.

Su Yuqing was a noble scion after all; how could he willingly lower himself to being a male concubine?

"That dog emperor is blind, letting that scumbag be prime minister, I really..."

Su Yuqing's explosive temper simply couldn't take it anymore.

Hearing the phrase "dog emperor," the green-robed man's heart skipped a beat with terror. Seeing Su Yuqing getting more and more carried away, he hurriedly reached out to cover her mouth.

He glanced left and right, pulled his hand back, and hissed in a low voice, "Are you out of your mind?! If my imperial brother hears you, in his imperial wrath he might execute your entire clan and have your head rolling!"

Upon hearing this, Su Yuqing instead beamed, her eyes shining brilliantly, "Really?! Then I must thank His Majesty!"

Splendid, that would avenge the original owner. Since the original owner was dead, that bunch of people were her indirect murderers.

This dog emperor actually had some practical use after all~

The green-robed man helplessly massaged his forehead; this person was definitely driven mad by confinement.

"Don't you want to get out?"

Su Yuqing shook her head and curved her lips into a smile, "Staying in this Cold Palace is pretty nice. No one bickering, no backstabbing scheming, just my Dabao and Xiaobao keeping me company. How wonderful."

The green-robed man: "..." Fine, he had nothing more to say. Wanting to stay in the Cold Palace made him a first-of-a-kind specimen.

"Your... Dabao and Xiaobao?" The green-robed man looked complicated. "You mean those two ferocious golden eagles?"

Su Yuqing was displeased. How were they ferocious? Can this guy talk? She shot him a glare. "They are very well-behaved!"

The green-robed man's mouth twitched; he sure hadn't seen any good behavior from those two eagles.

"Get lost quickly, don't disturb my wonderful life!" Su Yuqing waved her hand impatiently.

With that, she turned back toward the campfire.

The green-robed man raised his arm to block her path.

Su Yuqing gritted her teeth, barely squeezing out a brilliant smile, "Spit it out if you have something to say, or state your business!"

The green-robed man coughed and lowered his arm, "I can get you out of here. And I can even help you punish the people you want to punish."

Su Yuqing's mind stirred: The opportunity just presented itself like this? Slapping faces feels much better when you do it yourself, though. But was there really such a good deal?

"Conditions?"

The green-robed man smiled, "You'll find out tomorrow. It's definitely not something you wouldn't want to do!"

Su Yuqing waved dismissively; whatever.

...

Yet, Su Yuqing never in her wildest dreams imagined she would leave the Cold Palace under this kind of identity.

"By imperial decree, the emperor decrees: Today, the son of the Su clan... Lord Su, quickly receive the decree and follow this servant out of the Cold Palace."

Su Yuqing's dazed gaze slowly drifted onto the bright yellow imperial edict.

She cursed inwardly.

Damn it, Imperial Concubine Su!

You're the imperial concubine, your whole family are imperial concubines!

This was definitely done on purpose by that dog emperor!

"Lord Su?" The eunuch called out cautiously once more.

Su Yuqing sighed, took the decree, and said, "Thank you for the imperial grace, long live my Emperor, long live, long live!" My ass!

Whatever. Let her get out first and talk later.

Su Yuqing summoned Dabao and Xiaobao, glanced at the palace maids and eunuchs who had been startled into retreating several steps, and raised an eyebrow, "Let's go."

"Lord Su, this... these golden eagles are terribly ferocious..." The decree-reading eunuch swallowed hard.

Su Yuqing stroked Dabao's head and smiled, "They fell into the Cold Palace five years ago, and I raised them. They understand human nature quite well, as long as you don't provoke them, they're fine."

"Then... Lord Su, please follow this servant."

"Pardon the trouble."

Cheng'an Palace

Attended by a group of palace maids, having bathed and changed clothes, Su Yuqing stepped out from behind the bamboo screen wearing luxurious garments.

"His Majesty has arrived..."

A shrill voice pierced into Su Yuqing's ears.

Su Yuqing sighed helplessly; that dog emperor really played the part of a doting master to the hilt.

Look at that, she had just finished getting ready, and right on cue, he showed up.

Lin Mingchuan wore a dark-colored robe embroidered with gold dragons and auspicious cloud-patterned brocade boots.

His dark hair was bound by a double-dragon playing-with-pearl jade crown. He wore a jade mask on his face, revealing only a pair of dark, sharp, lustrous phoenix eyes and an alluring, perfectly shaped, naturally rosy pair of thin lips.

Radiating a fierce aura, he walked in slowly with his left hand clasped behind his back.

Su Yuqing hurriedly bowed, "Greetings..."

Before the words "Your Majesty" could leave her lips, Lin Mingchuan caught her and lifted her up.

"Beloved Consort, no need for formalities." Lin Mingchuan's deep, alluring voice, carrying a natural electric charge, drilled straight into Su Yuqing's ears, sending tingling sensations all over her body.

Su Yuqing: Holy crap, that dog emperor's voice is just too much!

This man must be drop-dead gorgeous!!!

Two blushes involuntarily flew up to Su Yuqing's ears.

Having practiced martial arts since childhood and possessing sharp vision, Lin Mingchuan instantly noticed the reddened ears of his little consort.

With a mischievous sense of amusement, he wanted to tease her further.

Lin Mingchuan waved his hand, and instantly, everyone in the hall except Su Yuqing retreated outside.

Su Yuqing was somewhat bewildered. What was this dog emperor trying to do?

Lin Mingchuan hooked his long arm around Su Yuqing's slender waist, pulling her into his embrace, while his thin lips brushed against her ear from time to time.

"How did my beloved consort's... ears turn red?"

Su Yuqing gave a start, her body turning limp as she leaned entirely against Lin Mingchuan.

Her ears were her most sensitive spot, and yet he was actually...

Lin Mingchuan's body stiffened for a second, then he scooped Su Yuqing up horizontally in his arms and strode toward the bed.

Recovering her wits and looking at the rapidly approaching bed, Su Yuqing felt everything was going south.

This dog emperor... actually wanted to indulge in broad daylight?!

No way, no way!

She was a pure, authentic girl! If he stripped her down, her head would surely roll tomorrow!

"Y-Your Majesty..." Su Yuqing lowered her head, feigning shyness.

Lin Mingchuan sat on the edge of the bed with Su Yuqing on his lap, reached out to lift her chin, and closely inspected those immortal-like features.

"Su Ming certainly knows how to pick them, offering you up to me."

"Your Majesty..."

"Shh~" Lin Mingchuan made a silencing gesture and reached out to untie Su Yuqing's waistband.

Su Yuqing's entire body stiffened, not daring to move an inch.

Damn it! He's actually doing this for real!

chapters.title: Serving in Bed
chapters.content:
Lin Mingchuan stripped Su Yuqing down to her undergarments, then pinned her onto the couch.

He leaned into the crook of her fair neck, inhaled deeply, and then planted a heavy, passionate kiss, leaving several hickeys before stopping with satisfaction.

Su Yuqing was completely dumbfounded.

What the heck!

Someone had just kissed her neck!

It was sucked so hard, it definitely left a mark!

No, this couldn't go on any further!

Su Yuqing decided to defend her purity.

"Your Majesty, it's still daytime... Doing this, I'm afraid..." Su Yuqing pressed one hand against Lin Mingchuan's solid chest, speaking in a coy and timid whisper.

"Inappropriate?" Lin Mingchuan chuckled softly. "You are my beloved consort, this is only natural~"

"Or could it be that my beloved consort is no longer pure?" Lin Mingchuan's phoenix eyes narrowed dangerously, his tone turning slightly cold.

Su Yuqing glared with eyes full of anger, a look of disbelief flashing across her face.

You jerk of an emperor, this is nothing but rumors and slander!

She was the only one in the cold palace, who could possibly have touched her?!

Catching the playful glint deep within Lin Mingchuan's eyes by chance, Su Yuqing sneered inwardly.

You like playing games, do you? Fine, this lady will play along with you.

"How can Your Majesty say such a thing to Yuqing? Yuqing holds Your Majesty in her heart, so naturally; naturally she has kept herself pure for Your Majesty, yet to think that Your Majesty would actually..."

As she spoke, teardrops fell like they were free of charge. She stubbornly bit her lower lip and raised a hand to wipe away the tears haphazardly.

Lin Mingchuan paused. Was this young man made of water? The tears came out the moment he wanted them to.

However, it was quite amusing, wasn't it?

Su Yuqing, son of Prime Minister Su Ming, let me see what you're truly capable of.

Lin Mingchuan sighed, took off his shoes, and lay down on the bed beside her.

"Your Majesty?" Su Yuqing was startled, though she didn't let it show on her face.

This jerk of an emperor had kissed her a few times, and now he had stopped. Was he letting her off the hook?

Lin Mingchuan closed his eyes and pulled her into his arms. "Attend to me in bed."

Bed service, attending in bed in broad daylight?!

Was he messing with her?!

Suddenly, Su Yuqing's pupils constricted, and she fell fast asleep right then and there.

Lin Mingchuan got up with a blank expression.

"Lin Yi."

A black shadow instantly appeared before him, kneeling on one knee.

"Master."

"Keep an eye on her. Report any movements immediately."

"Understood."

To make the act complete, Lin Mingchuan stayed for another half hour before leaving.

He even told the maids and eunuchs waiting in the outer hall, "Take good care of him, do not disturb his rest."

It wasn't until around three in the afternoon that Su Yuqing slowly woke up.

She raised a hand to rub her slightly sore neck, and thinking about how she had just slept all this time, she cursed inwardly.

Jerk of an emperor, that name really suits him!

Holy crap, a bite mark!

Su Yuqing hurried over to the bronze mirror, pulled open her collar, and several glaring hickeys appeared on her fair neck.

The jerk of an emperor was truly a dog, actually chewing her neck up like this!

Su Yuqing pulled at her collar, barely managing to cover some of them. However, this half-revealing look made it all the more alluring and seductive.

The more she looked, the more irritated she became.

This jerk of an emperor was definitely doing it on purpose!

"Someone come here." Su Yuqing took a deep breath.

A maid walked in.

"What are your orders, Consort?"

"There are no outsiders here, just call me Young Master." Su Yuqing raised a hand to pinch the bridge of her nose.

"Consort, I'm afraid that's not according to..."

"Rules are dead, but people are alive. Besides, rules were made by people in the first place. If anything happens, I'll take the blame."

Su Yuqing waved her hand, cutting off the maid.

"What is your name?"

"This servant is called Hongming."

"Good. From now on, you'll be in charge of them. Do a good job and you won't be treated poorly."

Hongming was overjoyed upon hearing this and hurriedly curtsied, "This servant thanks the Young Master!"

"Prepare some food." Su Yuqing thought of Dabao and Xiaobao, and added, "Prepare plenty of it."

"Yes, Young Master!" Hongming nodded.

Meanwhile.

The two golden eagles were preening their feathers out of sheer boredom.

[Brother, why do you think Mother hasn't come to see us yet?]

[We can just go find Mother ourselves.]

[Then let's go quickly!]

Just as they were about to spread their wings and fly, Su Yuqing's teasing voice drifted over.

"Where are you two going, hmm?"

Xiaobao's eyes lit up. It was the first to fly over to Su Yuqing, rubbing its little head against her clothes.

[Mother! Mother!]

Dabao cast a disdainful glance at its younger brother.

[Mother.]

"Dabao, Xiaobao, stand on Mother's shoulders, we're going to eat!" Su Yuqing grinned broadly.

[Okay!]

Evening.

"Dabao, bring those sugar cubes over here for a moment." Su Yuqing scooped out the Mapo Tofu and said.

A few seconds later, the sugar was placed on Su Yuqing's right side.

"Thank you, Da..." Su Yuqing turned around with a bright smile on her face, then her gaze shifted to astonishment, and she hurriedly bowed.

"Greetings..."

"I told you, there's no need to bow when you see me." Lin Mingchuan helped her up, his tone carrying a hint of helplessness.

Su Yuqing wore a smile on her face while secretly complaining internally: As if I'd dare! As the saying goes, accompanying the monarch is like accompanying a tiger. If I'm not careful, I won't even know how I kicked the bucket one day.

"Aren't all the maids in the palace here? Why did you cook yourself?" Lin Mingchuan frowned, his eyes tinged with a trace of heartache.

Su Yuqing smiled faintly. "It's enjoyable to cook and eat for oneself. Would Your Majesty honor me by having a bite?"

If she didn't have the original owner's memories, she would have believed it herself.

This acting was quite convincing.

Hurry up and refuse, then get lost immediately!

Lin Mingchuan didn't miss the fleeting look of anticipation in the depths of Su Yuqing's eyes, and slowly hooked his lips into a smile. "Alright, then I shall properly taste my beloved consort's cooking."

Su Yuqing wore a startled expression on her face. He actually agreed? She was just being polite!

Only for a second, Su Yuqing quickly composed herself. "Is there anything Your Majesty dislikes to eat, such as green onions, ginger, or garlic?"

"Anything is fine, I'm not picky." Lin Mingchuan's thin lips parted slightly.

Su Yuqing nodded, planning to make a dish of braised pork belly and call it a day.

Lin Mingchuan took two steps back, watching her fluid, practiced movements in the stir-frying, coupled with that ethereal appearance.

The corners of his lips curled up slightly. This feeling... seemed rather nice.

After the dishes were served on the table, Su Yuqing used serving chopsticks to taste each one of them, and smiled at Lin Mingchuan, "Your Majesty, these dishes are just right in saltiness, would you like to try them?"

Lin Mingchuan had always disliked being waited on while dining, but with his well-defined fingers, he picked up the chopsticks and picked up a piece of braised pork belly.

The moment it entered his mouth, his gaze flickered slightly.

He had thought Su Yuqing was just joking about cooking, who would have thought she actually had this skill?

"Your Majesty, how is it?" Su Yuqing asked expectantly.

Lin Mingchuan chewed a few times, swallowed it down his throat, and smiled with curved lips, "It tastes good."

Su Yuqing smiled even brighter. "Your Majesty, this Mapo Tofu is also good, and this Shredded Pork in Garlic Sauce is not bad either."

By the end of the meal, Lin Mingchuan was stuffed.

He decided he needed to exercise some restraint next time.

The hidden guards in the shadows: "!!!" They had never seen the master have such a good appetite.

"Your Majesty, I was afraid I'd stuff myself, so I made some hawthorn cakes, they taste quite good too. Would Your Majesty like to try some?" Su Yuqing pushed a plate of pastries toward Lin Mingchuan, finding it amusing to watch him stuffed yet pretending not to be.

Lin Mingchuan looked at her with his deep eyes, a hint of surprise flashing across them at this moment.

Su Yuqing still kept a smile at the corners of her lips, without a trace of cowardice.

After just a few seconds, Lin Mingchuan withdrew his gaze, picked up a piece of pastry, and began to eat.

Sweet and sour, it actually tasted quite good.

After eating two pieces, he looked at Su Yuqing, who was propping her chin in her hands and watching him.

"Go bathe."

"Huh? Huh?! Ah?!" Su Yuqing was so shocked that she sat up straight, alarm bells ringing wildly in her heart.

"Tonight, my beloved consort... will serve in bed." Lin Mingchuan's tone was languid, his phoenix eyestinged with a hint of profound meaning.

The hand hidden behind the table by Su Yuqing clenched into a fist, her teeth grinding fiercely.

Was this jerk of an emperor doing this on purpose, toying with her?!

Even if she was a favored consort, there was no need for him to constantly hang around here all the time.

And serve in bed?!

She was truly afraid she'd lose her little life shortly!

"What, is my beloved consort... unwilling?" Lin Mingchuan frowned, his tone deepening.

"Your Majesty... Yuqing is still young..." Su Yuqing lowered her head coyly, her ears half-hidden by her dark hair turning red.

In the Qiyuan Dynasty, males came of age at eighteen, and females at sixteen.

The original owner was disguised as a man, seventeen this year, still a year away from coming of age. It was not an exaggeration to say she was young.

Tsk, that scumbag father was also completely deranged; the original owner was offered to the emperor at the age of twelve.

Lin Mingchuan chuckled softly. "What are you thinking? We're just going to sleep, nothing else."

"Alright!" Su Yuqing agreed promptly, afraid that he would go back on his word.

Hearing this, Lin Mingchuan instead felt somewhat unsettled.

Then he frowned fiercely again. He must have truly lost his mind. No matter what, Su Yuqing was still Su Ming's son.

And he was going to uproot this tumor of the imperial court!

chapters.title: Laying Cards on the Table
chapters.content:
After Su Yuqing finished her bath, she saw Lin Mingchuan sitting at the desk... reviewing memorial memorials.

Su Yuqing walked over slowly, stopping two steps away from the desk, and called out softly, "Your Majesty..."

Faint traces left by him could be seen on her fair neck, which, paired with that ethereal celestial demeanor... made her look very much like a noble Tianshan snow lotus tainted with mortal desires.

Lin Mingchuan raised his eyes, his pupils constricting slightly, and he raised a hand to rub the bridge of his nose as if to cover it up.

"Go to sleep first, I'll come over after I finish reviewing the memorials."

Su Yuqing was full of doubts, but didn't dare to ask out loud, so she had to walk towards the bed.

Oh well, when soldiers come, block them; when water comes, earth covers it.

However, as soon as Su Yuqing touched the bed, she fell fast asleep.

Early the next morning,

"Mm... chestnut cake, mine..." Su Yuqing smacked her lips.

"Mare's milk cake, peach blossom pastry... no grabbing!"

Su Yuqing bit down hard on the object beneath her, and suddenly a wave of bone-chilling cold enveloped her, making her shrink inward in the cold.

"Su! Yu! Qing!" A cold and angry voice exploded right above her head.

Lin Mingchuan looked with a dark expression at the tooth marks on his chest and some nameless moisture, his anger rising.

Su Yuqing woke up immediately, lazily gave a yawn, and met Lin Mingchuan's angry eyes.

"Your Majesty, you're finally acting normal~"

Lin Mingchuan narrowed his eyes, his tone sharp. "What do you mean?"

Su Yuqing sat up and hooked her lips into a smile. "Your Majesty, let's not speak in riddles. When you had me brought out from that cold palace at this time, didn't you have some kind of scheme in mind?"

Lin Mingchuan looked her up and down, and smiled lightly. "You're quite sharp-witted."

"That prime minister father of yours has embezzled quite a lot of disaster-relief silver over the past two years by relying on his high position. He has also committed plenty of crimes like defying imperial law and killing the innocent at will. As the saying goes, the debts of the father fall upon the son..."

The veins on Su Yuqing's forehead throbbed violently as she smiled a smile that didn't reach her eyes.

To hell with the debts of the father falling upon the son!

That scumbag father, did he even deserve it?!

"Your Majesty, the man is still alive, naturally it's not my turn as a son."

Lin Mingchuan reached out and grabbed her chin, leaning closer, his hot breath spilling across her face.

"Yet, you are his son, that is an unchanging fact. What your father has done is enough to warrant the execution of nine familial generations..."

"If you want to stay alive, then show some sincerity."

Su Yuqing's face stiffened, and she gritted her teeth.

This jerk of an emperor was truly a dog!

"Your Majesty doesn't need to test me. If Your Majesty wishes to uproot this tumor, Yuqing will naturally assist. When the time comes, please grant Yuqing permission to leave the palace!"

Lin Mingchuan rubbed her plump red lips with his thumb, curving his lips in a wicked smile, his eyes filled with playfulness.

"You're quite ruthless."

"How can I trust you?"

Su Yuqing brushed Lin Mingchuan's hand away and said meaningfully, "Take the ice needed during this scorching summer heat, for instance. That ice is monopolized by my prime minister father. Why not tear open a gap and make it an ordinary commodity?"

Lin Mingchuan's gaze darkened, his expression turning serious as his thin lips parted. "You have a way?"

"Naturally. The ice my prime minister father has is chiseled out, so he naturally knows the method for storing ice. During the scorching summer heat, lacking ice is truly unbearable, so no matter how expensive it is, people will still buy it. But... what if this ice can be produced in batches?" Su Yuqing smiled with confidence, slowly spelling out what she had in mind.

"You know how to... make ice?" A flash of shock quickly crossed the depths of Lin Mingchuan's eyes.

Su Yuqing blinked. "I'll teach Your Majesty, and then Your Majesty can pass it down. Firstly, this breaks one of my prime minister father's financial streams."

"Secondly, not only nobles and royals, but even ordinary commoners can buy cheap ice. Once the commoners can buy it, they will naturally remember Your Majesty's kindness, and Your Majesty's realm will become even better."

Lin Mingchuan was stunned, then burst into hearty laughter. He laughed for quite a while before stopping, staring with burning eyes at the celestial-like person before him.

"This method is good."

"Before this matter is accomplished, you will be my most favored consort..." Lin Mingchuan promised word by word.

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow, instantly growing interested. She leaned closer to him and smiled slightly, "Your Majesty, if I commit a huge blunder one day, will you still favor me?"

"As long as you don't endanger this realm, I am willing to favor you." Lin Mingchuan curled his lips.

Suddenly, Lin Mingchuan reached out a long arm, pulling her into his arms, and his warm lips launched an unexpected assault on her neck.

Su Yuqing was so startled that she wanted to get up, but someone was faster than her, executing a swift turnover.

Positioning her beneath and him above.

Su Yuqing: "..."

Hadn't they already made things clear?

Now there was no one around, there was no need to act anymore, right?

Lin Mingchuan narrowed his eyes, glanced out of the corner of his eye toward the door, and whispered hoarsely into Su Yuqing's ear, "Someone is there, cooperate with me later."

Su Yuqing was stunned for a moment, looking toward the door, wondering if there really was someone?

You've got to be kidding me...

Lin Mingchuan turned her head back to make her look at him, a wicked smile curving the corners of his lips. "Beloved consort, do you know how to scream?"

As a qualified cooperating partner, Su Yuqing naturally tried her best to fulfill the request. She smiled brightly and raised her head.

"Piece of cake."

Afterwards, Lin Mingchuan, who was always expressionless, actually had ears flushed with a faint red, and the hands hidden behind his back kept clenching into fists.

Every time he looked at Su Yuqing now, his mind was flooded with images of her slightly disheveled clothes, eyes tinged with alluring springtime charm, and panting with parted red lips.

It really was...

Those two words lingered in his mind, threatening to take over his brain the next moment. He closed his eyes tightly, forcibly suppressing the thought.

"Your Majesty?" Su Yuqing tilted her head, giving him a cute, obedient smile.

"Don't smile." Lin Mingchuan gave a low, embarrassed scold, putting on a stern face. "Come here, help me dress."

Suddenly thinking of something else, a trace of annoyance tinged his brow. "No need, I can do it myself."

Su Yuqing, whose two feet had already touched the ground: "..."

Was he playing with her?

Lin Mingchuan quickly changed his clothes and strode out of the Cheng'an Palace.

Whether it was her imagination or not, both Su Yuqing and the hidden guards in the shadows felt that that tall figure carried a hint of fleeing in a hurry.

Su Yuqing rubbed her chin, carefully recalling Lin Mingchuan's series of actions just now, and her eyes grew brighter and brighter.

In the end, she burst out laughing.

If she hadn't guessed wrong, the jerk of an emperor had just been embarrassed.

Tsk tsk... An emperor actually being so pure and innocent.

Ahem, he couldn't still be a virgin, could he?

Thinking about it, he had been on the throne for five years now, and yet he hadn't done that even once?!

Could it be that he... had some hidden ailment?

Su Yuqing thought a bit too deeply, to the point that she didn't even hear someone calling her.

chapters.title: Countryfolk Meet Countryfolk
chapters.content:
"My Lord!" Hongming gritted her teeth and raised her voice.

Su Yuqing snapped back to reality immediately, turning her head to the side, "What is it?"

"What would Your Lordship like for breakfast?"

"Plain porridge and side dishes will do."

"As you wish, My Lord."

After the meal, as Su Yuqing was strolling alone, she heard a familiar tune.

It sounded like it was being played on a flute.

To verify her guess, she walked a little closer.

Su Yuqing closed her eyes to savor it carefully while involuntarily tapping her fingers in time with the rhythm.

Before long, the flute music stopped abruptly.

Immediately following it was a gentle, mellow voice.

"My Lord... you must be Su Yuqing, the son of Chancellor Su, right?"

Su Yuqing raised her head and looked in the direction of the voice. She saw a man dressed in moon-white robes holding a jade flute, a just-right smile curving the corners of his mouth.

Though the man's facial features were not of the celestial grace possessed by Su Yuqing, he was nonetheless gentle and handsome, belonging to that type of person who grows on you the more you look at him.

"And you are, brother?" Su Yuqing curled her lips into a smile.

"Xiao Jingqi," Xiao Jingqi said, his thin lips parting slightly.

"Xiao Jingqi... why does that name sound so familiar to me?" Su Yuqing's brows furrowed as she muttered to herself.

"Computer Science," Xiao Jingqi said quietly.

Computer Science? Computer Science!

Su Yuqing clapped her small hands together, her brilliant, shimmering eyes as dazzling as a starry sky.

"Xiao... Pang?" Su Yuqing asked tentatively, with a hint of expectation.

Xiao Jingqi smiled and nodded.

Su Yuqing felt wild joy in her heart.

Hahaha...

It was actually Little Pang!!

"Speaking of which, you too?" Su Yuqing trailed off, leaving her sentence unfinished.

Xiao Jingqi nodded helplessly.

"I'll be c, Damn it!" Su Yuqing suppressed the urge to curse and pulled Xiao Jingqi toward a pavilion.

Xiao Jingqi's gaze fell upon that slender, fair hand, a faint smile playing at the corners of his mouth.

Su Yuqing pulled him down to sit, looked left and right, leaned in close to him, and whispered, "When did you do the thing?"

If it had been anyone else, they certainly wouldn't have understood what Su Yuqing was trying to express, but Xiao Jingqi, who had lived with her for a year, was different.

She was asking him when he had transmigrated over.

"Three days ago," Xiao Jingqi shrugged helplessly. "And then it's been like this ever since~"

Su Yuqing smacked her lips, propping her chin in her hands. "I was two days ago, and then I got picked up and taken out of the Cold Palace."

Xiao Jingqi nudged Su Yuqing with his elbow, a hint of excitement and curiosity on his gentle, handsome face. "What's it like being a favored consort? Is the Emperor handsome?"

Su Yuqing rolled her eyes at him and retorted ungratefully, "Do you want this favored consort position? If so, you can have it!"

Then she excitedly went off on a tangent of her own: "Don't even get me started. Although His Majesty wears a mask, just going by that natural-born nobility and dominance, not to mention that slender, powerful body and those deep, well-defined facial contours. Tsk tsk..."

"I can bet for sure that His Majesty's looks are top-tier!"

Su Yuqing's intuition told her that the Emperor did not look bad at all.

The hidden guard in the dark scoffed inwardly: His Majesty naturally looks god-like, does it need two consorts like you to say so?

But when did the son of Chancellor Su become acquainted with the son of the Minister of Personnel?

The guard's brows furrowed slightly.

He had to report this to His Majesty immediately.

His figure flashed like a swooping bird, and he left without a sound.

Su Yuqing was extremely happy and dragged Xiao Jingqi running all the way back to her bedchamber.

As soon as they crossed the threshold, two golden eagles pounced forward.

[Mother!!]

Xiao Jingqi's pupils shrank sharply; he scooped Su Yuqing up and dodged out of the way.

"Jingqi, Jingqi, it's a misunderstanding! These two golden eagles are pets I keep!"

"You... you're keeping two national first-class protected animals?!"

"Ahem, anyway, can you put me down first?"

Su Yuqing coughed lightly and patted Xiao Jingqi's hand under the gaze of his shocked eyes.

Dabao and Xiaobao looked aggrieved and wronged.

Mother is bad! She went out to play by herself and didn't take them along!

Immediately afterward, sharp gazes shot toward Xiao Jingqi.

Who is this male human? Why is he holding onto Mother and won't let go?

Xiao Jingqi shivered all over from those glares, quickly released Su Yuqing, and muttered a small complaint, "Brother Su, these two golden eagle darlings of yours look like they're about to eat me!"

"It's fine, Brother Su has got your back~" Su Yuqing lifted her chin and patted her chest.

"Dabao, Xiaobao, what do you want to eat today? Tell me, and Mother will make it!"

Because she had run into someone familiar, Su Yuqing was in an exceptionally good mood.

[Mother, Xiaobao wants to eat meat~]

[Mother, Dabao wants to eat meat too.]

The two golden eagles, Dabao and Xiaobao, answered obediently.

Xiao Jingqi cast a look at Su Yuqing, the implication of which was self-evident.

Su Yuqing smiled and blinked at him. "Don't worry, braised pork will be in endless supply."

After the meal, Su Yuqing slumped bonelessly against the back of her chair, feeling completely satisfied as she said loudly, "So comfortable!"

Xiao Jingqi also lazily leaned against the back of his chair, narrowing his eyes as he sighed, "Brother Su, the braised pork you cook is still the best~"

[Mhm mhm! The meat Mother cooks is so delicious!]

Dabao and Xiaobao expressed unanimous agreement.

Su Yuqing radiated a lazy aura from head to toe. Hearing this, the corners of her mouth ticked upward of their own accord, and she waved a hand.

"It's alright, just alright."

"The Consort is certainly eating happily, hmm?" Lin Mingchuan walked in with his hands behind his back, taking leisurely steps. He glanced briefly at Xiao Jingqi before shifting his gaze back to Su Yuqing.

Su Yuqing's eyes widened abruptly. In her panic, she slid right off the chair and made solid contact with the floor.

Su Yuqing winced in pain, tears springing to her eyes.

She gave Lin Mingchuan a wronged glare, forgetting even to bow to him, and stood up while rubbing her backside.

"Greetings, Your Majesty," Xiao Jingqi hastily stood up and bowed.

Lin Mingchuan nodded, walked straight over to Su Yuqing who was picking herself up from the floor, reached out, and pinched her little nose. "Clumsy~"

A hint of gossipy amusement flashed in Xiao Jingqi's gentle eyes.

Has Brother Su actually won over the Emperor?

"Hurting badly? Shall I, your Emperor, rub it for the Consort?" As he spoke, he reached out a large palm as if to take action.

Su Yuqing sidestepped, her face burning with shame and anger as she glared at him huffily.

She was a genuine, flesh-and-blood girl!

How could she let a man rub her...

This scoundrel of an emperor really had the nerve to say that!

Xiao Jingqi: "..." So, what was he even doing here? Shouldn't he hurry up and leave?

"Your Majesty, Jingqi still has some matters to attend to, so I shall return to my quarters first."

"Mn."

Granted permission, Xiao Jingqi walked away at a very brisk pace, as if a ferocious beast was hot on his heels.

"Let's go, I'm taking you out of the palace today." Lin Mingchuan pinched her little cheek.

Su Yuqing's eyes suddenly lit up, her cool and aloof features taking on a touch of brilliance.

"Really?!"

"A sovereign never breaks his word~" Lin Mingchuan nodded, his deep eyes carrying a trace of gentleness.

"Yay! Your Majesty, you're the best!" Su Yuqing, wild with joy, gave Lin Mingchuan a big hug.

Lin Mingchuan's pupils contracted slightly.

She hugged him?!

The hidden guard in the dark: ！！！

She actually hugged the Master?!

"Ahem ahem~ Go change into something lighter first." Lin Mingchuan coughed lightly and patted her shoulder.

chapters.title: Beauty, Give Me a Kiss
chapters.content:
It was Su Yuqing's first time strolling through an ancient market street, and she found everything utterly fascinating, lingering excitedly in front of various stalls.

Candied haws!!

Su Yuqing's eyes lit up.

The person selling candied haws was an old grandfather, who revealed a kind smile, "Little young master, would you like some candied haws? Made right at home, four wen a coin a stick, sweet and sour, super delicious~"

Su Yuqing swallowed hard before she could stop herself, and just as she reached out to pay, she rummaged around for a long time without finding a single coin.

Wonderful, she didn't bring any money.

When they parted ways, His Majesty didn't give her any money!!

"Aiyo, little beauty, want to eat candied haws? Give this young master a kiss, and this young master will buy the whole lot for you, how about that?" a flippant male voice came from behind her.

Su Yuqing turned around and lazily raised an eyebrow.

A man dressed in lavish robes, leisurely shaking a folding fan, approached her, wearing what he thought was his most charming smile.

"Little beauty, why aren't you speaking? Could it be you've been struck dumb by this young master's striking elegance?"

Su Yuqing blinked and let out a chuckle, adding a touch of playfulness to her cold, immortal-like aura.

Tsk tsk, this guy didn't even look as good as Lin Yi, a mere hidden guard, where did he get the confidence?

"B-Beauty..." The man stared at Su Yuqing, who looked like a goddess descended to earth, as if he had lost his mind. He muttered and raised a hand, wanting to touch her face.

She actually looked somewhat familiar with this guy; wasn't this the very same jerk who used to bully the original body when they were kids~

Since she ran into him today, she wouldn't let him off without teaching him a lesson.

When it came to people like this, Su Yuqing always had a fiery temper. With a wicked curl of her lips, she smashed her fist viciously into his nose.

"What kind of disgusting trash is coming around to dangle in front of me!"

"Ah! You...!"

With a loud bang, the man was knocked flat on his back by a single punch.

Su Yuqing stared at her own fist in disbelief. Good grief, she had actually managed to knock down a tall guy well over six feet.

Su Yuqing, you really are something else.

"Oo, oo dare hit me! I wanna make u my male concubine! Make u wish oo were dead e-e-every single day! (You, you dare hit me! I want to make you my male concubine! Make you wish you were dead every single day!)" The man grimaced in pain, struggling to stand up from the ground, his eyes full of lewdness and greed.

"You're lisping so much through the gap in your teeth, you'd better not talk; listening to you makes me uncomfortable~" Su Yuqing waved her hand in disgust.

"Hmm... where's a good place to hang him?" Su Yuqing tapped her chin, eyeing her surroundings, when her eyes inadvertently swept across a spot and lit up.

Ah! What a great spot! That's the one!

Su Yuqing snapped her fingers and said loudly, "Xiaobao, hang him..."

She pointed a finger, "Hang him right there, right there!"

With a swoosh, a shadow grabbed the man and hung him up precisely at the spot Su Yuqing was pointing at.

"Tsk tsk... That's quite a view, full panoramic scenery~"

"Hey! Didn't you say you had striking elegance? Well, I'm doing you a great favor by letting everyone see you with their own eyes and making you famous, huh?"

"No need to thank me."

Su Yuqing clapped her hands, the playful amusement in the depths of her eyes growing even richer.

The man was so angry he simply passed out cold.

Xiaobao glared and gave him a swipe of its talons.

Hmph! Daring to harbor malicious thoughts toward its mother? In your dreams!

"Xiaobao, come back~" Su Yuqing waved at the majestic golden eagle.

As soon as Xiaobao heard Su Yuqing calling it, it immediately flew toward her with joy, retracting the strength in its talons as it landed obediently on her shoulder.

[Mother~]

Xiaobao rubbed its head against her cheek in an act of attachment.

"Good boy~" Su Yuqing raised a hand to stroke its head, the corners of her mouth lifting.

[Mother, Mother, Daddy gave silver, can eat food!]

Xiaobao lowered its head to look at the small money pouch hanging around its neck.

Daddy?

Su Yuqing's brows furrowed slightly as her gaze fell upon the tiny character "Chuan" embroidered in gold thread on the money pouch.

Could it be... His Majesty?

"Xiaobao, the daddy you mentioned was the one from when we were eating earlier..."

[Yeah yeah!] Xiaobao nodded.

Su Yuqing removed the money pouch, weighed it in her hand, and curled her lips into a smile. "Grandpa, I'll take two sticks of candied haws!"

The old man stared in astonishment at the golden eagle, which was as obedient as a rabbit, and then handed over two sticks with a kind smile.

"Thank you, Grandpa." Su Yuqing accepted them and handed over the money.

"Ah, sure thing, come back if they're good~" the old man replied repeatedly.

Up on a restaurant balcony not far away, a man in red robes lazily lifted his eyelids and tilted his head back to finish the wine in his cup.

He stood up, pulling his robes together to cover his honey-colored, sturdy chest and the faintly exposed abdominal muscles.

His features were full of exotic charm, a mesmerizing smile curved the corners of his mouth, and his voice was deep and magnetic, carrying the rich mellowness of post-drinking intoxication.

"To make such a fierce bird of prey obey like that... she really is quite something..."

Over here...

Armed with money, Su Yuqing began a sweeping spree, eating her way through the snacks from one end of the street to the other.

"Hiccup~" Su Yuqing burped with satisfaction, her eyes curving into crescent moons. "Xiaobao, are you full?"

Xiaobao rubbed against her cheek.

[Mother, all these things are so delicious!]

"Right?!" Su Yuqing was naturally pleased to get Xiaobao's affirmation.

Well-fed and content, it was time to get down to business.

chapters.title: First Encounter in Red
chapters.content:
Where was she supposed to go to buy saltpeter?

Wait, what was saltpeter called in the Qiyuan Dynasty again?

It seemed to be called Earth Frost...

Pharmacies should sell it, right?

Never mind, I'll go check out a pharmacy first.

Huan'an Hall

"This... young master, is there something you'd like to buy?" The young girl glanced somewhat fearfully at the golden eagle, summoning her courage to ask softly.

Su Yuqing noticed, stroked Xiaobao's head, and explained, "Xiaobao understands human speech, it won't hurt anyone casually."

Xiaobao glanced at the young girl, and with a somewhat aggrieved expression, buried its head against Su Yuqing's neck.

[Mother is still the best!]

Su Yuqing's eyebrows curved into smiles, and after stroking its back once more, she finally looked at the young girl.

"Do you have any Earth Frost for sale here?"

Only then did the young girl catch sight of Su Yuqing's appearance, her doe-like eyes rounding out completely, her little face flushing bright red.

Such... such a pretty person!

And their voice was so gentle, too.

"Miss?" Su Yuqing called out softly, inwardly wondering; if they didn't have it, her trip would be in vain.

The young girl remained dazed for quite a while before snapping back to her senses, stealing a quick glance before lowering her head again, her voice as soft as a mosquito's buzzing, "Young master, what would you like?"

"I'd like some Earth Frost, do you have any for sale?" Su Yuqing hadn't heard clearly, so she stated the purpose of her visit directly.

The young girl nodded vigorously, "We do. Ten wen per liang. How much does the young master need?"

Ten wen per liang...

By the prices of the Qiyuan Dynasty, it wasn't considered expensive. She'd buy a little to try out first.

"Then please help me weigh out three liang of Earth Frost."

"Alright, please wait a moment, young master."

[Mother, when are we going back to find Daddy?]

Su Yuqing felt a headache coming on. Just what had Lin Mingchuan done to win these two golden eagles over?

They were even calling him "Daddy" now.

"Xiaobao, he is not your daddy, you are not allowed to call him that."

[But didn't Mother marry Daddy?]

Xiaobao tilted its head.

Su Yuqing gave a dry laugh, deciding to end the topic right there.

"Be good~ Let's not talk about this anymore."

[Mother, can we eat something delicious when we get back?]

"Of course!"

"This golden eagle the young master keeps is truly exceptionally well-raised." A man dressed in gorgeous red robes with seductive features said, envy showing in his eyes.

Su Yuqing raised her gaze. He was a strikingly handsome man with a dissolute and unrestrained air, his honey-toned chest quite captivating to the imagination.

"Aren't you afraid?"

The man in red covered his mouth with a laugh, seduction rippling between his brows, "Why would I be afraid? I love it too much, this golden eagle is so pretty~"

[Mother, Mother, he praised me for being pretty!]

Xiaobao happily rubbed its head against Su Yuqing.

Su Yuqing smiled with indulgence, "You, you really do have the heart of a child."

The man in red's eyes flickered slightly, "Might I be allowed to pet it?"

"Xiaobao?" Instead of answering directly, Su Yuqing turned her head to look at the golden eagle on her shoulder.

[Well, Lord Xiaobao will... will reluctantly let him pet me then.] Xiaobao lifted its little head proudly.

"Xiaobao says you can pet it." Su Yuqing extended a hand for Xiaobao to stand on.

The man in red smiled, his well-articulated fingers gently stroking Xiaobao's head. "You call it Xiaobao, could there happen to be a Dabao as well?"

Su Yuqing nodded.

"I found it by a coincidence of fate, so I kept it."

"Young master, the items you requested have been prepared." The young girl carrying the packaged Earth Frost walked up behind Su Yuqing and said softly.

Hearing this, Su Yuqing turned around, taking the package with one hand while handing over the money with the other.

Well-fed and watered, and the goods were in hand too. Mmm... time to go have some fun.

"I should be going now. Farewell." Su Yuqing smiled and nodded slightly toward the man in red.

The man in red's gaze fell upon that receding, slender figure, his brows knitting together before smoothing out again.

A slight smile hung on the corners of his lips as he murmured softly, "Farewell..."

Lanxiang Tower

A flash of excited smiles appeared on Su Yuqing's face as she rubbed her hands together impatiently.

Tsk tsk... an ancient brothel~

Today, she would finally get to satisfy her wish and take a look.

Hidden not far away, a secret guard: "!!!"

This imperial concubine is going to cuckold His Majesty?!

No, I must hurry and report this to His Majesty.

At this moment, Su Yuqing was still entirely unaware that she was about to be caught red-handed by the ruler of the realm. Full of excitement, she adjusted the mask on her face and stepped into Lanxiang Tower.

"Oh my, little young master, what kind of lady are you looking for? Everyone here in our Lanxiang Tower is an absolute beauty~" The madam waved her handkerchief, swaying her waist with boundless charm as she approached Su Yuqing.

Su Yuqing's gaze inadvertently swept across the swell of the madam's bosom, a trace of shock inevitably flashing through her eyes.

Good heavens, this... must be a D-cup at least?!

She looked down at her own...

No, no, no... her own size was just fine, she wouldn't have this much trouble when running.

The madam was an expert at reading expressions. Her eyes shifted slightly as she pulled over a curvaceous, hot-bodied woman with a similarly towering bosom and shoved her straight into Su Yuqing's arms.

The woman stumbled, then bonelessly and smoothly slumped against Su Yuqing, her cleavage pressing right up against Su Yuqing's flat chest.

Su Yuqing: "!!!" Damn it, what is this texture?

"Heyao, take good care of this young master." The madam instructed with a teasing smile.

Heyao wore a shy expression, her body trembling slightly. Hearing the madam's command, she hesitated for a few seconds before resigning herself to a nod.

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow. This young lady looked like it was her first time, judging by the looks of it.

So be it. Mutual benefit; she needed a living, and she herself just wanted to take a look around.

"Do you know how to play tunes?" Su Yuqing curved her lips into a smile.

Only then did Heyao raise her head. When she met those gentle eyes, a warmth spread through her heart, and she nodded softly.

She slowly withdrew from Su Yuqing's embrace, her voice carrying a trace of gentle softness, "Young master, please follow this servant."

"Try taking one step and see what happens." A cold voice mixed with a hint of fury came from behind.

chapters.title: Come Here, Help Me
chapters.content:
The smile on the corner of Su Yuqing's lips instantly froze.

We're totally screwed.

Why did His Majesty come here?!

"Y-Your Majesty, big... older brother, why did you come?" Su Yuqing hurried over to curry favor in front of Lin Mingchuan.

Waves of chilling aura emanated from Lin Mingchuan, sparks seemingly igniting within his deep pupils.

This little thing had grown quite bold. Having entered his harem, even if they hadn't gone all the way, she was still his person.

To think that upon leaving the palace gates, she had actually wandered into a brothel.

Lin Mingchuan swept a glance over the scantily clad, hot-bodied woman, his handsome face turning dark. The chilling air around him grew heavier by several degrees.

Very well, daring to seek out this kind of woman, not even caring if her scrawny little frame could handle it!

Every hair on Su Yuqing's body stood on end. With a do-or-die attitude, she hugged Lin Mingchuan's arm and acted coquettishly toward him, "Older brother~ I didn't even have time to do anything yet, so stop being mad, okay? Won't you please?"

Veins throbbed on Lin Mingchuan's forehead. He was so angry he laughed, "So, you're saying it was still older brother who interrupted your good time?"

Su Yuqing practically wanted to slap herself across the face. What kind of nonsense was she spouting? Wasn't this just adding fuel to the fire?!

"No, no, no, older brother, let's go back. I promise I'll never come again! Otherwise, you can do whatever you want with me!" Driven by a particularly strong desire for survival, Su Yuqing shook her head rapidly.

Lin Mingchuan let out a "tch" and hoisted Su Yuqing right over his shoulder.

The world instantly spun around for Su Yuqing. By the time she regained her senses, they had already walked out of Lanxiang Tower.

Inside the Carriage

The atmosphere between the two of them was awkward. Neither spoke, and they just sat in stiff silence all the way back to the palace.

Su Yuqing's eyes were sharp and fast as she tried to dismount the carriage, only to have her wrist clamped in a death grip by a large hand.

The owner of that large hand gave a gentle pull, dragging Su Yuqing's entire body straight into his embrace.

"Let... this Emperor hold you!" Lin Mingchuan's whole body was scorching hot, and the only thing emitting a comforting, cool breeze was the little person in his arms.

"So comfortable..." Lin Mingchuan buried his entire head in Su Yuqing's neck, his burning thin lips sporadically pecking and kissing here and there.

Su Yuqing's body stiffened like a wooden post, not daring to move an inch.

Lin Mingchuan furrowed his brows, seemingly displeased by Su Yuqing's stiffness. A large hand cupped her chin, and he kissed her fiercely.

Su Yuqing's pupils shrank to pinpricks, completely forgetting to resist as she let Lin Mingchuan kiss her until her entire body went limp in his arms.

Lin Mingchuan lowered his head to gaze down at the little thing, whose lips were slightly swollen and red, panting heavily. A wicked smirk curved his lips, "Little fellow, you're that fellow Lin Mingchuan's favored concubine? Tastes pretty good."

That fellow Lin Mingchuan?

He wasn't Lin Mingchuan?!

A flash of terror crossed Su Yuqing's eyes.

With a heavy dose of mischievous amusement, Lin Mingchuan groped at her vaguely exposed, delicate collarbones, suddenly recalling the heart-fluttering gasps from earlier. His gaze swept downward.

He actually...

"Come here, help this Emperor..."

Su Yuqing's eyes widened, "H-Help with what?"

Lin Mingchuan smiled wickedly, his large arm sweeping around her slender waist to hold her tight, his voice hoarse to the extreme, "What do you think, Qing'er? Hmm?"

Th-Th-Th-Th-That... that reacted?!

Su Yuqing felt as though she had been struck by lightning, her small body trembling all over.

This was from sheer anger.

This dog of an emperor, is he out of his mind?!

Help him? He must be out of his mind wishing for that!

Su Yuqing smiled wickedly, "Your Majesty, we were merely putting on a show. To put it another way, I am merely your strategist."

Lin Mingchuan let out a light laugh, his large hand clamping her delicate chin to force her to look up. "A strategist? We've already kissed, are there really... strategists who satisfy romantic desires?"

"Since you are now my imperial concubine, you should fulfill the duties a concubine ought to have..." Lin Mingchuan tilted his head to peck a kiss onto her cheek, his voice lazy, "And the primary duty is to serve, please, and satisfy one's own sovereign~"

Su Yuqing's heart sank. Was this guy trying to go back on his word?

No way!

"Is that so~ Your Majesty, I've always only served people who look good. At least... people who look like me." Su Yuqing replied with a smile, even pointing at herself with her finger.

This dog emperor had always worn a mask. Either he thought wearing it was fun, or he had some reason that forced him to wear it.

Judging by these past few days, it was probably the second scenario.

This dog emperor definitely couldn't take it off.

A seductive, tingling low chuckle exploded right beside Su Yuqing's ear.

"This Emperor shall grant Your Beloved's wish~"

chapters.title: Teasing, Poison Flare
chapters.content:
Lin Mingchuan's hand slowly raised, just as he was about to take off the mask.

Su Yuqing stared unblinkingly, her eyes glowing with brilliance, terrified of missing a single thing.

The corners of Lin Mingchuan's lips curved, his gaze turning somewhat dazed, and his hand fell back to his side.

Su Yuqing, filled to the brim with anticipation, widened her eyes. What's going on?!

Just like this?!

The dog emperor lied to her!

"My beloved?" Lin Mingchuan tilted his head, his jet-black hair reaching his waist gently brushing across the back of Su Yuqing's hand, bringing a trace of itching sensation.

Su Yuqing frowned deeply, turning her head away, "Your Majesty does not keep your word!"

A trace of playful amusement flashed swiftly across Lin Mingchuan's eyes as he feigned innocence, "My beloved, you look so pretty, just like a fairy from heaven!"

With a strange expression, Su Yuqing turned her head back to look Lin Mingchuan up and down carefully. After a few seconds of silence, she asked, "You... are there something wrong with your brain?"

While speaking, she even tapped her own temple with her finger.

Lin Mingchuan's mouth fell into a pout, his deep black eyes unexpectedly welling up with a watery sheen, and his normally deep and magnetic voice surprisingly carrying a hint of babyish innocence.

"Beloved is mean, how can you say that to Chuan'er? Chuan'er is very smart, Chuan'er is going to punish Beloved!"

As he spoke, two sturdy arms firmly imprisoned Su Yuqing within his embrace, and a hand mischievously gave Su Yuqing's backside a pinch.

Su Yuqing's body instantly stiffened.

"Beloved, so soft~" Lin Mingchuan praised with a smiling gaze, giving it another casual pinch for good measure.

"Beloved, how about accompanying this Emperor in a bath tonight?" Lin Mingchuan buried his head in the crook of her neck, his hair lightly brushing against her collarbone.

Su Yuqing couldn't help but shiver. Damn it, this spot shouldn't be touched!

"Since Beloved isn't speaking, this Emperor will take it as Beloved's agreement." Full of vigor, Lin Mingchuan picked up Su Yuqing and stepped out of the carriage, heading straight for his sleeping quarters.

Su Yuqing: "?" At least... give me a chance to speak!

"Someone, prepare hot water and scented soup!" Holding Su Yuqing, Lin Mingchuan ordered loudly as he strode into his bedchamber.

Su Yuqing shivered. Oh crap, this won't do! If I take a bath with the dog emperor, wouldn't my disguise be blown in a matter of minutes?

No way, absolutely not!

Think of a way, she had to hurry and think of a way to escape this bath!

Got my period? That definitely won't work, she was currently a "man."

Or should she fake a stomachache, or fake fainting?

Tsk, the dog emperor would probably summon an imperial physician, exposing her right away. That's even worse!

Then what could she do? It seemed there was simply no way out!!

Anxiously biting her index finger, Su Yuqing knitted her brows tightly.

"Beloved~ Are you hungry? Shall I have food brought in?" Lin Mingchuan asked with concern.

Su Yuqing raised her head, nodding like a chick pecking at rice, her eyes shining brightly.

Stalling for time was better than nothing. She needed to calm down first; maybe a solution would present itself.

A playful glint lingered at the bottom of Lin Mingchuan's eyes, and he promptly ordered the meal to be served.

The imperial kitchen was certainly efficient. Before long, dishes were laid out on the table; they looked, smelled, and appealed wonderfully, appearing extremely tempting.

"Eat." Lin Mingchuan tipped his chin upward.

Upon receiving permission, Su Yuqing's gaze glued itself to the gold-inlaid jade chopsticks on the table. She swallowed hard.

"Why aren't you eating? Is Beloved waiting for this Emperor to feed you?" A gentle smile bloomed on the corners of Lin Mingchuan's lips as his well-articulated fingers picked up the chopsticks, grabbed a meatball, and brought it to her lips. "Want a taste?"

Su Yuqing blinked her eyes, hesitated for a moment, opened her mouth to eat the ball, and chewed. A spark of brilliance burst from her eyes.

Mmm~ Delicious~!

The chefs who cooked for the emperor really were something else, huh?

The moment she swallowed it down, a sharp pain struck from her heart, feeling as though a blade was fiercely twisting right there. It hurt so badly that she lost all strength in her body and fell backward.

Su Yuqing wanted to curse out loud from the pain: "..." Damn it, this hurts like hell!!

Lin Mingchuan's pupils shrank violently. He hurriedly caught her in his arms, his tone urgent and panicked, "Beloved, what's wrong with you?"

Su Yuqing felt like crying without tears. She pressed her hand tightly against her heart, gritting her teeth just to keep herself from trembling so violently, "I-I have a chest pain! It hurts so much..."

Actually, she wanted to say that her entire body hurt!!

She had lost big time; she had just wanted a bite to eat, and as a result, she ended up taking the hit for the dog emperor.

Was she going to die just like this? She hadn't even properly explored the Qiyuan Dynasty yet!

And her Dabao and Xiaobao were still waiting for her to make good food!

Lin Mingchuan was about to summon an imperial physician, but when his eyes landed on the messily scattered dark blood vessels on Su Yuqing's face, his deep pupils were overtaken by shock and complexity.

"Lin Yi, quickly go invite Young Master Yu."

"Understood."

Su Yuqing was already in so much pain that she was losing consciousness, vaguely sensing someone touching her face...

chapters.title: You Called Me Noble Consort?!
chapters.content:
"Thank you for your hard work, Ziqing."

"Heh~ I'm old acquaintances with this poison. I never expected that once you left, she would inherit it."

"Judging by how the poison has taken root, she probably carried it in her mother's womb. Today, some other toxin in her meal simply stirred it into action; otherwise, it would have been nearly impossible to detect."

"Is this poison worse than my previous one?"

"Tsk tsk... Your favorite consort has turned a misfortune into a blessing. She's now completely immune to all poisons~"

Su Yuqing had just regained consciousness when she was hit with this earth-shattering piece of news, leaving her pretty face utterly blank for a moment.

Immune to all poisons?

Her?

She was fine?!

Su Yuqing tried to sit up with a jerk, but her whole body ached so badly that she could only let out a mournful wail.

"Goddamn it, it hurts..."

Lin Mingchuan was the first to stride over to the bed. He pulled back the curtains and gently helped Su Yuqing up. "Are you still feeling uncomfortable anywhere?"

Su Yuqing dizzily shook her head, her gaze shifting to the handsome man in celadon robes who had followed him in. Whether it was her imagination or not, the man looked at her with a hint of ambiguous amusement.

"Why is Your Ladyship the Noble Consort looking at me like that?" The handsome man's lips curled into a faint smile.

Imperial... Noble Consort?

Where on earth was there an Noble Consort here?

Su Yuqing's gaze darted back and forth before she pointed a somewhat disbelieving finger at herself. "You... called me Noble Consort?!"

A flicker of playful amusement crossed the handsome man's eyes as he smiled faintly and nodded.

"Her Ladyship the Noble Consort protected the Emperor with merit, so His Majesty elevated your rank."

Su Yuqing's shoulders slumped, devoid of any joy.

She didn't want to be any damn Noble Consort at all!!!

The higher the status, the more trouble came with it. Was this dog of an emperor doing this on purpose?!

Disregarding Lin Mingchuan's identity as the emperor, Su Yuqing glared at him viciously.

Dog emperor, why on earth did you blindly promote my rank?!

Lin Mingchuan pulled her into his arms by the shoulder and raised his eyes to look at the handsome man. "Ziqing, take her pulse again."

Again?

Take her pulse?!

Su Yuqing's heart skipped a violent beat, a wave of dizziness washing over her. The look she cast at the handsome man was tinged with a trace of sheer terror.

This guy definitely knew she was a woman in disguise!

Would he expose her?

The handsome man was still smiling all over as he stepped forward and pulled Su Yuqing's wrist toward him.

His cold fingertips made Su Yuqing shudder involuntarily, and she snatched her hand back like a flash.

"Recovering nicely. You should eat blander food these days." The handsome man gave Lin Mingchuan an ambiguous look, gave a light cough, and added, "Some things... are better done less often."

What things?

What was he dropping hints about?

Su Yuqing knitted her brows slightly.

Lin Mingchuan glared at the handsome man unhappily. "Fine~ Then how about Ziqing attends to me in bed tonight?"

Su Yuqing's eyes widened. She looked at the handsome man, then back at Lin Mingchuan, as a flame of gossip ignited in her heart.

Tsk tsk... A gentle, handsome shou, and a devoted, dominant emperor gong; this CP is totally ship-worthy!

And offering service in bed tonight? Hehe, go get him, hurry up!!

Catching the fanatical and excited look on Su Yuqing's face, the handsome man wore a peculiar expression before offering a soft smile.

"Why is Her Ladyship the Noble Consort so excited? Could it be that you feel Ziqing has stolen your favor?"

Su Yuqing shook her head like a rattle-drum. "No, no, no, steal away! Steal as much as you like, as long as you're happy!!"

Steal it, steal it! Once stolen, she wouldn't have to worry every day with trembling fear that someone would expose her female identity!

Besides, isn't shipping a CP wonderful?

Speaking of which, would this handsome guy named "Ziqing" expose her?

Su Yuqing felt a full-blown headache coming on. She never expected that she'd barely been out of the Cold Palace for a few days before being found out.

What kind of rotten luck was this?!

"My beloved consort, rest assured. No matter what, you will always be my most favored consort." Lin Mingchuan took Su Yuqing's slender fingers and pecked them lightly.

Su Yuqing mentally screamed, Holy shit. What on earth was this dog emperor doing? If he liked men, fine, go ahead, why drag her into it?!

No matter how capable she was, she couldn't magically grow that piece of equipment.

The handsome man covered his mouth with a slight smile. It seemed the imperial palace was going to get a lot more interesting from now on.

"Your Majesty, then Ziqing will take his leave."

chapters.title: Making Ice Successfully, the First Cup of Milk Tea
chapters.content:
By this time, the news of Su Yuqing being conferred the title of Noble Consort had spread throughout the entire palace.

Across the palace, some rejoiced while others worried.

"Damn Su Yuqing! It would have been fine if she had just stayed obediently in the Cold Palace, but she had to come out and snatch His Majesty's favor from me!!" A pampered and alluring woman in gorgeous robes gritted her teeth as she gripped the armrests of her chair, looking as though she wanted to tear Su Yuqing limb from limb.

"Your Ladyship, calm your anger. Why would you lose your temper over a mere man? If Your Ladyship conceives a dragon seed in the future, you will be the supreme ruler of this inner court," a palace maid nearby whispered with a lowered head and a smile.

Only then did the gorgeous woman temper her mood. She raised a hand to stroke the bead bracelet on her wrist and let out a seductive, charming laugh. "That's true. After all, she's someone who can't bear children~"

---

Cheng'an Palace

"Your Majesty, can you put Yuqing down now?" Su Yuqing raised her head slightly to probe.

Beneath her hips were Lin Mingchuan's firm and warm thigh muscles. For someone who had never had such intimate contact with any man other than her own father, this could only be described as torture.

"What are you wriggling for? Are there needles under your backside?" Lin Mingchuan wrapped his large palm around Su Yuqing's slender waist, his voice low and husky.

Su Yuqing's body stiffened as her mind instantly flooded with things her girlfriends used to talk about, unstoppable.

Ahem... There were indeed no needles on her backside, but...

"Your Majesty, I bought the things to make ice. Shall I make some for you to see?" Feeling awkward, Su Yuqing quickly changed the subject to something Lin Mingchuan cared about.

Knowing she was trying to shift his attention, Lin Mingchuan went along with her, his tone flat. "What do you need to prepare?"

"Not much. One large and one small wooden basin, and a wooden bucket of water," Su Yuqing replied with a beaming smile.

Lin Mingchuan raised an eyebrow imperceptibly, his gaze shifting slightly as he gave the orders.

---

"Your Majesty, look! It's that simple!" Su Yuqing tapped the water that had frozen into ice, the faint wisps of mist radiating a refreshing coolness.

Curious, Lin Mingchuan squatted down and touched it with his hand, a wave of chill spreading from his fingertips.

It really was ice.

To have it made just like that, truly magical.

"Your Majesty, with this earth-frost and water, you can make ice!" Su Yuqing shook the paper packet of medicine in her hand, her face bursting into a brilliant smile that was as charming as a blooming Tianshan snow lotus.

"Quite clever, indeed." Lin Mingchuan's lips curled into a faint smile.

Suddenly, Su Yuqing leaned in close to Lin Mingchuan's face, staring at him intently. "Your Majesty, would you like to drink milk tea?"

Gazing at those parting and closing red lips, Lin Mingchuan's eyes darkened slightly, and he stood up on the spot. "My consort can drink it yourself; I have important state affairs to attend to."

"Alright, Your Majesty." Su Yuqing's eyes held a deep, rich smile.

Whether there were important affairs or not, she didn't know, but this dog of an emperor was definitely embarrassed.

Tsk tsk... This dog emperor was so full of contradictions.

Oh well, never mind him.

"Hongming, are everything and everyone prepared?" Su Yuqing looked at Xiangming, who was waiting nearby.

"Rest assured, Your Ladyship, everything is ready," Hongming said with a gentle smile.

Su Yuqing rubbed her hands together happily. Hehe, milk tea, here I come.

Watching her master mix cow's milk with roasted tea leaves, carefully filtering the mixture into another bowl, and finally adding some chipped ice, Hongming was filled with curiosity.

"Hehe, mission accomplished!" Su Yuqing grinned from ear to ear. She picked up the bowl and took a sip. The tea was rich, the milk mellow, and the sweetness just right. "Ah! Refreshing!"

Su Yuqing smacked her lips in satisfaction. Although ancient times lacked advanced technology and convenient transportation, the quality of the food here was simply top-notch.

"Hongming, how much milk and tea leaves do we have left?"

"Is Your Ladyship planning to make some and send it to His Majesty?"

"Ahem... Of course!"

Su Yuqing covered her mouth with a cough and said with a deadpan, earnest expression.

Actually, she was just asking because she wanted to make some other treats.

Since she had nothing else to do in this imperial palace, tinkering with food was the only thing that could bring her joy.

Being a lazy fish who could eat well and knew how to eat well was more than enough.
