Once that matter was settled, she would leave the imperial palace and travel across all mountains and rivers.

Ah, just thinking about it was wonderful. Hahahaha...

chapters.title: Meeting the Scumbag Father
chapters.content:
In the end, Su Yuqing still carried her food box to two different places before finally catching up with Lin Mingchuan.

Not to mention, a focused Lin Mingchuan looked even more handsome and charming.

Before Lin Mingchuan could even speak, a minister standing nearby sprang into action, opening his mouth with a rebuke.

"Your Majesty, we are discussing matters of vital national importance. How can someone from the inner court come to interrupt?"

Lin Mingchuan raised an eyebrow, propping his head with one hand, his eyes shimmering with a hint of mischievous amusement.

Su Yuqing, how will you refute this?

I'm so looking forward to it~

Su Yuqing frowned. This voice sounded a bit familiar. Someone she knew?

Steading the food box, she turned her head to look.

Tsk, isn't this the original body's scumbag father?

Su Yuqing scrutinized him inch by inch with a suspicious gaze, practically wishing she had a magnifying glass to walk right up to him with.

Having served as Chancellor for so many years, Su Ming would have been a fool not to notice such an obvious and scorching gaze.

Instantly displeased, he spoke up, "For this noble consort to stare at the Prime Minister like this, what kind of decorum is this?"

Su Yuqing felt a sudden chill. With her temper flaring up, she snapped right back at him, "I see you looking so ordinary, with a mediocre face, and yet you lack three heads and six arms. Where do you get the authority to stop His Majesty from eating and ruin his body? Do you not want His Majesty to get well?!"

"No matter how formidable His Majesty is, he's still human and has to eat. Unlike some people who have floated in the clouds for too long and forgotten what it feels like to have their feet on the ground."

"Don't you think what I'm saying makes sense, Lord Prime Minister?" Su Yuqing smiled brightly, her eyes curving into crescents.

Su Ming's gaze fell upon that face, which looked as ethereal as a deity's, and he fell into a daze, as if that person had appeared before him once more.

"You... are you Yuqing?"

Su Yuqing curled the corners of her lips, her tone lazy. "Nope~"

Giving a light huff, she carried the food box and walked in a few steps right up to Lin Mingchuan. "Your Majesty, food is heaven for the people; no matter what, you have to eat something."

Lin Mingchuan raised a hand to catch Su Yuqing's slender fingers, his tone gentle and doting. "Why did my beloved consort chase all the way here? Can't bear to be away from me for even a moment?"

Ahem... This dog emperor gets into character fast enough.

Look at those eyes brimming with deep affection; if it were any other young girl, she would have fallen for it in a minute.

Su Yuqing sighed inwardly while feeling a slight tickle on her hand.

Looking up, she saw that Lin Mingchuan's fingers were stroking the back of her hand, his eyes clearly reflecting her dazed face.

Su Yuqing shuddered, barely managing to keep herself from yanking her hand back and slapping Lin Mingchuan across the face.

Good grief, this dog emperor, what is he randomly touching for?!

The ministers below looked at the two of them flirting ambiguously, unsure whether they should stay or withdraw for the moment, so they could only lower their heads and keep completely silent.

Except for Su Ming.

"Your Majesty, a country cannot go a day without a Queen! For the sake of the state and the rivers and mountains, this minister implores Your Majesty to appoint a Queen as soon as possible!" With that, he dropped to his knees and performed a respectful, full-kowtow greeting to Lin Mingchuan.

Lin Mingchuan chuckled coldly and shot Su Yuqing a look.

Su Yuqing was startled. Holy crap, you're leaving this to me to handle?!

Appointing a queen or whatever had nothing to do with her.

With a strong pull, Lin Mingchuan drew Su Yuqing into his arms, leaned close to her small ear, and said in a low, husky voice, "Now it's your turn to fully utilize the privileges of a favored consort~ Don't let me down~"

Su Yuqing pouted. Dog emperor, using her as a shield; she really hadn't called him a dog emperor wrong.

"In your position, play your part," Lin Mingchuan added.

Su Yuqing glanced at Su Ming, brewed her emotions, cleared her throat, and prepared to unleash her inner debater.

"Then according to the Prime Minister, which family's young lady possesses such virtues as being virtuous and wise, delicate and exquisite, gentle and considerate, pure as ice and clean as jade, spiritually gifted and brilliantly talented, pitiful yet endearing, graceful in all postures, quiet as a virgin yet nimble as a rabbit, skilled with her hands, well-read and courteous, heartbreakingly touching, capable of managing the formal hall and the kitchen alike, able to endure loneliness, and capable of creating glorious achievements, which family's noble daughter is she?"

Su Ming: "..."

Other ministers: "..."

Hidden guards in the shadows: "!!"

Lin Mingchuan burst out laughing, hurriedly coughing to hide his uncontrollably upward-curling lips with his wide sleeve.

This little one really spat out words like a machine gun; it must have been tough on her to string together so many adjectives.

Thank goodness he had never truly angered her; otherwise, facing that little mouth, he genuinely wouldn't have a comeback.

Lin Mingchuan poured a cup of tea and handed it to Su Yuqing's lips.

Staring at the cup of tea for a few seconds, Su Yuqing figured she happened to be thirsty, so she simply drank the tea following that posture.

Very good, no longer thirsty.

Seeing the absolute silence below, Su Yuqing spoke up again. "If the Prime Minister has a candidate in mind, please do inform him. With such a woman helping His Majesty, we consorts will be very happy too."

Su Ming gritted his teeth hard and stayed silent.

Where on earth could one find such a woman? That was pure daydreaming.

An ungrateful, unfilial little wretch, daring to reject his face as a father like this!

Good! Very good!

Truly wonderful!

Now that she was favored, her wings had hardened!

Just wait until he found a chance to knock this wretched girl down a peg!

"What, the Prime Minister has no candidate? Then this matter of appointing a Queen shall be temporarily shelved." Su Yuqing wore a fake smile, her little mouth continuing the barrage with full firepower, "His Majesty is the sovereign of the nation, and this Queen naturally must be worthy of His Majesty. Trying to hoodwink His Majesty and annoy him by bringing in some stray cats and mangy dogs is hardly what a good minister should do."

"All you Lords are fine ministers of the Qiyuan Dynasty; you wouldn't do such a thing, right?"

"Your Majesty, please grant your brilliant judgment; this minister and the others would never dare do such a thing, Your Majesty!"

A whole crowd of ministers dropped to their knees one after another, neat as could be.

Whoa! That was fast!

Su Yuqing tossed a slight toss of her chin toward Lin Mingchuan, who had been watching the show with keen interest.

The subtext was: Your turn.

chapters.title: Leaving Without a Trace
chapters.content:
Lin Mingchuan simply played deaf and dumb, raising a hand to massage his temples and pretending to have a headache.

Su Yuqing was so angry she laughed. Fine, so she was supposed to block for him all the way to the end, is that it?

"Do the esteemed lords have any more important or urgent matters? If not, please return to rest and allow His Majesty to dine."

The ministers looked at each other, then spoke in unison, "This official takes leave!"

If they didn't leave now, they feared this imperial concubine would find an excuse for His Majesty to strip the official caps right off their heads.

These days, being an official was not easy!

The hidden guards in the shadows: "!!!" This imperial concubine was somewhat formidable, single-handedly holding her ground against a crowd of ministers.

Su Yuqing glanced over, a flash of astonishment tinting her eyes. Whoa! The original owner's scummy father was still here?

Still wanted to struggle a bit more?

Hmph, she wasn't going to play along!

"Angry?" Lin Mingchuan got up, embraced Su Yuqing from behind, and gave an indulgent smile.

"Hmph, you are not allowed to go to Cheng'an Palace tonight!" Su Yuqing gave Lin Mingchuan a coquettish glare, turned on her heel, and walked away as if acting angry.

Lin Mingchuan stared at the departing figure, shaking his head helplessly, his eyes full of indulgence.

"Move all the memorials to Cheng'an Palace. I will be reviewing memorials there for the next few days," Lin Mingchuan instructed before lifting his feet to chase after Su Yuqing.

Over here...

Su Yuqing walked with flying strides while humming a cheerful little tune, feeling wonderfully pleased inside.

Hahaha... Back to the palace, back to the palace, that's the end of dealing with that.

My precious daybed, wait for me to come back and dower you.

"Noble Consort."

A gentle voice rang out.

Seeing who had arrived, the smile hanging on Su Yuqing's face stiffened into a half-smile, half-grimace.

Crap! Why was it him?!

Wasn't he going to rat me out?

Yu Ziqing watched the celestial-like person before him whose expression changed rapidly on that small face, finding it rather amusing.

Whatever she was thinking, it was all written on her face.

"Ziqing won't tell. That is a little secret between Ziqing and Your Ladyship the Noble Consort." Yu Ziqing smiled slightly at her.

Su Yuqing gave a dry laugh. My good man, you'd better not smile; your smile gives me the creeps.

"Ah, fine, fine, fine." Su Yuqing nodded and walked past him. Her first few steps were at a normal speed, but right before rounding the corner, her feet churned as if equipped with Wind-Fire Wheels.

Mommy dearest, how terrifying! When could she ever leave this imperial palace?!

Turning his head to look, Yu Ziqing happened to catch this exact scene, and the corners of his mouth couldn't help curving into an attractive arc.

Lin Mingchuan, having caught up, raised a brow, somewhat surprised to run into Yu Ziqing here.

Mingzheng Hall

Lin Mingchuan dismissed everyone except the hidden guard Lin Yi.

"A-Chuan, are you serious about Su Yuqing?" Yu Ziqing asked the question on his mind the moment he spoke.

Lin Mingchuan was silent for a moment, his eyes filled with coldness, devoid of even a shred of tenderness. "Like father, like son; the son of a rat can dig holes. He is Su Ming's son; how could I possibly be serious about him? Even if he weren't, I wouldn't trust someone I've only spent a few days with. After all, you know a person's face, but not their heart."

"It's merely playacting."

Su Yuqing, who had returned halfway back and possessed extremely sharp hearing upon hearing this, curled her lips in a cold smile and turned to leave.

Fine, it was a waste of her effort to help him. The reward she got was "you know a person's face, but not their heart," is that it?

Dog emperor, she was a very petty person.

None of the three realized that Su Yuqing had returned.

This undoubtedly planted a massive mountain in the path of Lin Mingchuan's future wife-chasing journey.

Cheng'an Palace

Su Yuqing sprawled on the comfortable daybed, eating iced fruit and drinking iced milk tea.

She also had two little treasures making her laugh.

Ah, this was simply too comfortable!

Dog emperor, scummy father, and the rest of you; all of you, get lost.

[Mommy, this fruit is so delicious!] Xiaobao shook his head in satisfaction.

[Mommy's cooking is even better.] Dabao lifted his little chin.

"Dabao, Xiaobao, how about we have a full fish feast tonight?" Su Yuqing blinked her eyes.

[Yay!]

chapters.title: Flirting, Don't Touch the Ears
chapters.content:
No sooner said than done.

Su Yuqing deliberately changed into narrow-sleeved clothing to make it easier to handle the fish.

"Your Ladyship, let us slaves do it. With your thousand-gold precious body, how can you do this kind of work?"

The maidservants nearby kept trying to snatch the work out of Su Yuqing's hands.

Su Yuqing processed the fish at lightning speed. Hearing this, she feigned anger, "Where did this thousand-gold precious body come from? All of you, get out, and don't come disturbing me!"

"Your Ladyship..."

"Hmm? Can't I order you around anymore?"

"No, no, no, we slaves are going out right now!"

Glancing at the palace maids who quickly departed, Su Yuqing washed the fish clean, sliced the fish meat into thin, even slices, and arranged them neatly on a plate.

[Wow! Mommy, what are you going to make?]

Su Yuqing blinked her eyes and smiled faintly, "You'll know in a moment!"

"Your Ladyship! Your Ladyship! Your Ladyship!!" Xiangming rushed into the small kitchen, panting heavily. "Your Ladyship, His Majesty has come, and he even had people move his memorials over..."

Catching her breath, she continued, "He said he will be lodging in Cheng'an Palace for the next few days."

Su Yuqing wore a frustrated expression and waved her hand. "He comes, so he comes. Why are you rushing so much?"

Xiangming opened her mouth. "Your Ladyship, His Majesty, he..."

"It's fine. His Majesty won't blame us."

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow and began chopping the fish meat on the cutting board with a knife, drowning out the sound of her own voice.

On the surface, she was currently the dog emperor's most favored imperial concubine; naturally, she could afford to be a bit willful and temperamental so as not to live up to the name of a favored concubine.

Besides, the dog emperor had no interest in her, so he certainly wouldn't do that kind of thing with her. Thus, she didn't need to worry too much about her cross-dressing being discovered by the dog emperor.

Aside from all that, this slacking life seemed pretty good.

"Beloved Consort!" A familiar, deeply magnetic male voice rang out.

Hearing it, Su Yuqing ignored him and continued chopping the fish on the cutting board.

A favored concubine, she was a favored concubine now.

Being a bit willful was completely OK.

Deep within Lin Mingchuan's fathomless, rippleless eyes, a trace of helplessness spilled over. He stepped lightly to Su Yuqing's side and coaxed, "Are you still angry?"

"How about I accompany my beloved consort in Cheng'an Palace these next few days?"

Su Yuqing chopped the fish while casually replying, "How would Yuqing dare to be angry with His Majesty? The moment you get displeased, you'll just send me back to the cold palace again~"

Lin Mingchuan's eyes flickered slightly. He wrapped his arms around Su Yuqing's slender waist from behind, leaned in close to her ear, and lowered his voice. "Recently, the Empress Dowager's people have been watching me. Play along with me."

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow, slowed down her fish-chopping, pondered for a moment, turned her head slightly, and also lowered her voice. "How should I play along?"

"Just play it by ear." Lin Mingchuan smiled faintly.

Xiangming, along with the rushing palace maids and eunuchs: "!!!"

Shouldn't he/they be leaving right now?

The two masters were just like this...

No one could be blamed for thinking this; it was simply that the postures of Su Yuqing and Lin Mingchuan at the moment were far too ambiguous. From everyone's perspective, the two of them looked like they were kissing.

Su Yuqing curved her lips into a smile.

Play it by ear?

That meant improvising on the spot, then.

Since that was the case, bring it on, dog emperor.

Su Yuqing nodded knowingly, then said reproachfully, "Then Your Majesty tell me yourself, where did you go wrong?"

Everyone looked shocked: "!!!"

His Majesty truly doted on Your Ladyship/Young Master.

If Su Yuqing knew what they were thinking, she would definitely go Hahaha; the dog emperor wasn't doting on her at all, he was clearly trying to use her as a human shield.

Lin Mingchuan pondered for a bit, found no answer, and gave a flattering smile. "I ask my beloved consort to enlighten me."

His eyes held a hint of warning, along with an increase in the force holding her waist.

Su Yuqing cursed inwardly, but on the surface remained unrelenting. "Then about this morning's matter of establishing an Empress, shouldn't Your Majesty explain yourself?"

A trace of surprise flashed across the depths of Lin Mingchuan's eyes. Picking up on the cue, he flatteringly brushed his lips against her ear. "Beloved consort, establishing an Empress is a matter of time, but I promise my beloved consort that you will be the treasure in my palm and the flesh of my heart, and no one can ever replace you."

Two flushes of crimson rapidly climbed up Su Yuqing's ears. She felt as though her ears were about to be melted away. With eyes brimming with moisture, she glared at Lin Mingchuan.

Dog emperor, how could he touch her ears?!

Her ears and neck were extremely sensitive!!

Su Yuqing slowly exhaled a breath, looking with earnest sincerity into Lin Mingchuan's deeply affectionate eyes, and spoke. "Your Majesty, can you please stop touching Yuqing's ears?"

Her ears were truly sensitive; if she hadn't been holding on for dear life, her legs probably would have gone weak.

chapters.title: The Emperor Who Cooks
chapters.content:
Lin Mingchuan was somewhat taken aback. Staring at this person with a celestial visage, he suddenly found it rather amusing. "Is my beloved consort's ears ticklish?"

Su Yuqing nodded. "Indeed. Your Majesty, promise Yuqing not to touch them next time."

"And..." Su Yuqing exhaled again. "Your Majesty, Yuqing is going to cook now, you..."

"I'll help my beloved consort prep." Lin Mingchuan cut her off, pulled back his hand, and stood beside her with an indulgent smile.

Su Yuqing lowered her knife at this, looking at him with suspicious eyes and probing, "Your Majesty, are you sure?"

This dog emperor was of supreme nobility; he probably had never even done chores like picking vegetables, yet here he was saying he wanted to help her prep?

"Does my beloved consort not trust me?" Lin Mingchuan smiled helplessly, stepped past her side, and picked up the knife lying on the cutting board. "How is this fish meat supposed to be made after being chopped up?"

"Ahem, make fish balls," Yuqing replied.

Lin Mingchuan nodded, chopping the fish meat with practiced ease, not caring at all whether fishy odors would stick to his clothes.

As a man, Lin Mingchuan had plenty of strength and quick movements, and he soon chopped the fish meat into a fine mince.

"Beloved consort, what should be done with these fish..." Lin Mingchuan turned around to ask, only to find Su Yuqing holding a golden eagle in one arm while sitting on a small wooden stool, her other hand supporting her chin, her little mouth slightly parted as she slept soundly.

Lin Mingchuan froze. His voice just now hadn't been particularly quiet; how could she fall asleep like this?!

Oh well.

Lin Mingchuan approached Su Yuqing, picked her up, and walked out of the small kitchen.

...

Su Yuqing was woken up by a wave of fragrance.

Her eyes half-opened, she sleepily stepped off the bed, her little feet searching the floor for her shoes. After searching for a moment and finding nothing,

she frowned in dissatisfaction. Where were her shoes?

Which person had come into her room and made her shoes disappear again?

"Clumsy!" Lin Mingchuan reprimanted lightly.

Su Yuqing frowned deeply and snapped back angrily, "You're the clumsy one, your whole family is clumsy!!"

"Crap, where are my shoes, huh? Why is it so cold?" Su Yuqing muttered as a sudden chill arrived, enveloping her in layers.

"Would my beloved consort care to repeat those words for me to hear?" Lin Mingchuan's low voice carried a hint of chilliness.

Su Yuqing straightened her body, widened her eyes, and thoroughly woke up.

She raised her eyes and locked gazes with Lin Mingchuan's dark, smiling-yet-not-smiling eyes.

Ahem, it was actually the dog emperor?!

Why was the dog emperor here?

Oh right, the dog emperor had been lodging with her these past few days.

"Why is my beloved consort not speaking now?" The corners of Lin Mingchuan's mouth curved upward.

Su Yuqing offered a fawning smile and walked toward him. "Your Majesty, it was just a slip of the tongue!"

Lin Mingchuan nodded, unsure whether he believed her words or not.

"Come eat."

Eat?

Who cooked?

Could it be the dog emperor?

Seeing no one following him, Lin Mingchuan turned his head and happened to see Su Yuqing furrowing her brows in thought. He stepped forward and grabbed her small hand.

"What is my beloved consort spacing out for? Come accompany me for a meal."

Su Yuqing dazedly let Lin Mingchuan lead her along, until she saw the exquisitely presented and aromatically appealing dishes arrayed on the table. For some reason, her gaze landed on Lin Mingchuan.

This whole table of dishes, made by the dog emperor?

"Why are you staring at me? Is there food on my face?" Lin Mingchuan raised an eyebrow.

"Indeed. Your Majesty is a feast for the eyes," Su Yuqing blurted out her inner thoughts subconsciously.

The next second.

Su Yuqing's mind exploded: Ahhhhhhhh!!! She actually said it out loud?!

Hearing this, Lin Mingchuan swept a peculiar glance over her and seated her at the table.

"I rarely cook, so I don't know if it suits my beloved consort's palate."

Lin Mingchuan's eyes flickered slightly, a suitably gentle and soft smile hanging on his lips. Picking up jade chopsticks, he picked up a fish ball and brought it to her lips.

Su Yuqing blinked her eyes, stared at the fish ball right in front of her mouth, struggled internally for a moment, and finally ate the fish ball with the air of one meeting their doom.

The moment her teeth bit into the fish ball, a trace of surprise crossed Su Yuqing's eyes. The fish ball was bouncy, chewy, full of flavor, and completely devoid of any fishy smell.

My gosh! Delicious!!

This dog emperor actually had pretty good culinary skills!

Ahem... Of course, it was just a tiny bit worse than hers.

Lin Mingchuan naturally didn't miss the look of surprise in Su Yuqing's eyes. Seeing her satisfied expression, he knew he had succeeded.

A person perched on a tree not far away watched the harmonious interaction between the two, a flash of disdain and contempt quickly skimming across their eyes.

Hmph, who knows why the Empress Dowager has to be on guard day and night!

Not only against this perverted emperor, but now they even had to watch this male concubine who came out of the cold palace!

What kind of waves could a discarded member of the Su clan possibly stir up?

Curling their lips, they zipped away in a flash.

Inside the hall, Lin Mingchuan leisurely ate the dishes while hiding a trace of cold sharpness in the depths of his eyes.

chapters.title: Live Palace Drama
chapters.content:
Mother, oh Mother, this is son's last chance for you.

After finishing the meal, Lin Mingchuan went to review memorial tablets, while Su Yuqing stood aside to grind ink for him.

Su Yuqing ground the ink while secretly glancing at the several stacks of memorials piled upon the desk.

Goodness, if one had to review this many memorials in a single day, it would be enough to choke a horse!

These piles must be as high as her navel!

Thinking back, she had once encountered a stack of things this high; the carefully selected test papers her family's resident genius brother gave her, and they were physics test papers that she had sworn eternal enmity with!!

Still, that kind of misery only happened during senior year of high school.

As for being an emperor, these memorials kept coming until abdication.

Tsk, being an emperor is no easy job~

Bathed in the glow of candlelight, one ground ink while the other reviewed documents, a most harmonious scene.

Early Morning

Su Yuqing woke up hot.

Frowning, she reached out to shove away the burning hot arm tightly wrapped around her waist.

"Fidgeting for what, hm?" Lin Mingchuan, sensing the unusual stirrings in his own body, found his voice turning somewhat husky.

The thick-skinned Su Yuqing naturally didn't notice, continuing to struggle, "Your Majesty, don't hold Yuqing so tight, Yuqing is so hot~"

Her soft, warm voice carried a hint of coquettishness, her red lips pouting slightly.

Lin Mingchuan's gaze darkened. He released her first, stepped out of the bed, and walked at a brisk pace toward the bathing spring in the back hall.

Su Yuqing tilted her head, then let out a huge yawn and called out loudly, "Someone come."

"Your Ladyship, what are your orders?"

Hongming's respectful voice came from outside the curtains.

"Prepare breakfast." Remembering Lin Mingchuan's dietary preferences from yesterday, she added, "Make it lighter."

"Yes."

"Your Ladyship, shall I prepare tea and pastries?"

Hongming asked cautiously.

Su Yuqing raised her hand to pull aside the curtains, getting out of bed wearing only her inner garments and trousers. Hearing this, she raised an eyebrow, "Why prepare them? Is someone coming this morning?"

Hongming was slightly startled, and respectfully replied, "Your Ladyship, you are currently the highest-ranked person in the harem and are acting on behalf in holding the Empress's seal. Naturally, the palace concubines will come to pay their respects to you."

Pay respects?

Acting on behalf to hold the Empress's seal?

Hoo, this was practically just one step away from an empress-conferring ceremony.

Tsk, wouldn't her current status make her a thorn in everyone's side, a nail in everyone's eye?

Su Yuqing rubbed her chin in thought for a moment, her gaze turning resolute, "Hongming, prepare them. We shall go take a look."

Cheng'an Palace

No sooner had Lin Mingchuan left than the concubines and consorts from various palaces arrived.

Su Yuqing wore a luxurious moon-white robe, her waterfall of ink-black hair half-bound simply with a bamboo-patterned embroidered silk ribbon, sitting steadily in the main seat.

"Greetings to the Noble Consort."

The concubines followed the rules, bowing and offering their greetings to Su Yuqing.

Except for one charming woman dressed in light-purple palace attire who glanced at her arrogantly, a contemptuous smile hooked at the corner of her lips, without even bending her knees or waist.

"No need for formalities, everyone sit." Seeing this, Su Yuqing's lips curled slightly.

"Thank you, Noble Consort!"

To think there were still women in the dog emperor's harem.

Quite pretty to look at, too bad her gaze was trash.

Su Yuqing sized up the charming woman, and the charming woman naturally sized her up in return.

The charming woman withdrew her gaze, covered her mouth and chuckled, "Noble Consort, as a man, you have grown to be so overwhelmingly alluring. No wonder His Majesty disregarded the Empress Dowager's objections to welcome you out of the cold palace."

Su Yuqing raised an eyebrow and smiled faintly, "Thank you for the praise, I also think I look quite good."

"Pfft... cough cough..." Xiao Jingqi at the side desperately suppressed the upward curve of his mouth, hurriedly picking up his teacup to take a sip as cover.

As expected of her brother Su, what a comeback.

Yu Ziqing's lips curved upward, his eyes smiling as he leisurely picked up his teacup and took a sip.

The two men sitting on either side of him, one stared at Su Yuqing with rapt interest, a wicked smile playing on his lips.

The other was nibbling on a pastry, sitting obediently, yet also sneaking sideways glances at Su Yuqing.

The smile on the charming woman's face froze, turning into a sigh as her voice went sweet and tender, "Noble Consort's beauty is peerless indeed, but you shouldn't monopolize His Majesty. Which of the sisters in this harem doesn't wish to see His Majesty?"

"With the Noble Consort acting like this, do you want His Majesty to have no heirs?" The charming woman's voice unconsciously turned sharp.

Hearing this, some concubines wore pleased expressions, while others looked strange.

Their ranks weren't high, so naturally they wouldn't dare bring this up with the favored Noble Consort, but the person before them was different.

She was the Empress Dowager's own niece, holding a very noble status indeed.

They had been in the palace for some time now, yet hadn't even caught a glimpse of His Majesty's face. If the opportunity arose, they would definitely fight for His Majesty's favor.

Su Yuqing laughed, casually lifting her eyelids, "A person's legs grow on His Majesty; wherever His Majesty wants to go, he goes. Who can stop him?"

"Besides, His Majesty is currently robust and in the prime of his youth. Do you think His Majesty cannot protect the security of the nation and its state affairs, or do you believe a single imperial heir can protect them?"

"Even though His Majesty spends every night staying in my quarters, he is merely reviewing memorials. All of you are free to use whatever methods you have to win His Majesty's favor."

"Just don't come looking for trouble with me. I find it extremely annoying, and once I'm annoyed, I naturally want the person responsible to be annoyed right along with me."

"Alright, everything that needs to be said has been said, you are all dismissed." Su Yuqing waved her hand.

Tsk, this chair was hard as a rock, it made her backside hurt. Her imperial concubine lounge chair was much more comfortable.

chapters.title: Drunk, Mistaken Identity
chapters.content:
The charming woman stood up first and stormed out of Cheng'an Palace in a rage.

Once outside the hall, she gripped her handkerchief tightly, her eyes vicious and venomous.

Damn Su Yuqing, how dare she monopolize His Majesty.

The Empress Dowager will not let you have your way.

"Your Ladyship, are we returning to the palace?" A palace maid nearby asked with tentative caution.

A smug smile appeared on the charming woman's face, "We're going to the Empress Dowager's palace."

Inside the Hall

With most of the concubines gone, Su Yuqing also stood up, wanting to return to her lounge chair for a rest.

"Noble Consort, please stay a moment." Yu Ziqing spoke softly.

Su Yuqing looked toward the source of the voice, feeling a jolt of alarm inside.

My god, why is it him?!

"Is something the matter?" Su Yuqing looked at him with puzzlement.

On the surface, she and he could be considered love rivals. Did this refined beauty want to set a trap for her?

"That day I frightened Your Ladyship, Ziqing wishes to offer an apology." Yu Ziqing said truthfully.

"There's really no need. If you have no urgent business, you should head back too." Su Yuqing smiled and waved her hand dismissively.

"Noble Consort, I heard that you love peach blossom brew. Ziqing happens to have a few jars of it. Would you... do me the honor of tasting it?" Yu Ziqing still wore a smile on his lips.

Peach blossom brew?

Su Yuqing licked the corner of her lips; she hadn't drunk that in a long time indeed. But this refined beauty's intentions were unknown; wouldn't it be a bit dangerous if she went?

Sensing her hesitation, Yu Ziqing suggested, "Shall I have someone deliver the peach blossom brew to the Noble Consort's palace instead?"

Su Yuqing's heart was quite tempted, but outwardly she put on a troubled look, "I'm afraid... that wouldn't be very appropriate."

Watching the trace of anticipation in the depths of Su Yuqing's eyes, Yu Ziqing chuckled inwardly, though outwardly he said, "Nothing inappropriate about it, as long as the Noble Consort likes it."

In the end, several jars of peach blossom brew were delivered to Cheng'an Palace.

Su Yuqing dismissed the palace maids and eunuchs, took the wine, and climbed up a tree, sitting securely on a thick branch.

She pulled out the stopper, and a wave of wine fragrance rushed to her nose, lingering and refusing to disperse.

"Mmm~ So fragrant!"

Su Yuqing pressed her mouth to the jar opening and took a small sip. The rich wine fragrance immediately filled her mouth, and she happily dangled her legs.

Then, aiming the jar opening at her mouth, she tilted her head back. The wine vanished like a silver thread flying into Su Yuqing's throat.

"Ah, refreshing! Drinking wine like this is actually interesting!" Su Yuqing put down the wine jar and boldly wiped her mouth with her sleeve.

At this point, Su Yuqing's small face already showed a hint of drunkenness, her cheeks flushed red, even the corners of her eyes tinted with a rosy hue.

Her pair of eyes were moist and sparkling, as if a galaxy had been crushed inside them.

Her waterfall of dark hair fell loosely behind her, and a breeze playfully caught a few strands of hair, making her look from afar like an immortal who had fallen into the mortal realm.

Su Yuqing was already tackling the third jar of wine. If Xiao Jingqi were here, he would definitely be able to tell that she was completely plastered.

Clutching the wine jar in her arms, Su Yuqing wobbled her way down from the tree to the ground, aimed the jar opening at her mouth again, and drank heartily.

"Awesome! Hahaha..." Su Yuqing stumbled over to the stone table and sat down, muttering to herself, "Peach blossom dock... peach blossom hermitage, under peach blossom... hermitage peach blossom immortals, peach blossom immortals... plant peach trees, then pick... peach blossoms to sell for wine money. Awakening from wine, I only sit before flowers..."

When Lin Mingchuan and his entourage arrived, this was what they saw: Su Yuqing reciting poetry while drunk.

"Hahahaha... I'd rather... grow old and die amid flowers and wine, unwilling to bow before carriages and horses. Dust of carriages and hooves... chase after wealth, wine cups and flower... branches are the lot of the poor. If... one compares wealth to poverty, the one is on... flat ground... the other in the sky; if one compares... poverty to carriages and horses, they get to rush about... while I get leisure. Hiccup~ Others... laugh at me for being too crazy, I laugh at others... for failing to see through it~ You don't see the tombs of the heroes... of Wuling, with no flowers... and no wine, they hoe them into fields~"

"Mmm~ My head hurts so much, why is this sky keeps swaying and swaying~" Su Yuqing propped herself up on the stone table with one hand and shook her head hard, "Holy crap, stop moving!"

Suddenly, Su Yuqing raised her head abruptly to look at Lin Mingchuan, her lower lip pouting. She stumbled forward, threw herself into his arms, wrapped her arms around his lean waist, and wailed tearfully, "Mommy... Qingqing misses you so much, misses your peach blossom pastries, misses your peanut paste... Wuwu~"

A flash of surprise crossed Lin Mingchuan's eyes, which instantly turned into helplessness. Even when drunk, she didn't forget to talk about food.

"Mother~ Don't leave... Qingqing..." The strength of her grip around Lin Mingchuan's waist grew tighter and tighter, her small head buried in his chest as teardrops fell patter-patters, wetting the clothes over his chest.

Lin Mingchuan was silent for a long time. His large palm gently patted her back, and he sighed, "Be good~ Mother isn't leaving..."

"Mmm, Qingqing is good..." A smile unconsciously appeared on the corner of Su Yuqing's mouth.

Yu Ziqing and the other two looked on with stunned expressions, seemingly surprised that Lin Mingchuan would tolerate someone to this extent, and a drunken person at that.

It didn't seem like he was completely heartless after all...
